7.20.d: मन्दरे विहरतो देवदेवस्य पार्वत्याः प्रार्थनया विन्ध्याचलमागम्य तत्र मनसा निर्मिते महापुरे योगसन्धानमास्थाय तया सह महासुरतारम्भः . तन्निमित्तात् महोत्पातान् दृष्ट्वा भीतैर्देवैर्विन्ध्यमागत्य शंकरदर्शनार्थं तत्सविधे लक्ष्यदूतरूपेण वह्नेः प्रेषणम् . तत्र नन्दिनोऽनुग्रहेण वह्नेरभ्यन्तरप्रवेशः . वह्नेः प्रार्थनया देवदेवस्य महासुरता- त्तूष्णीं निष्क्रम्य देवेभ्यो दर्शनदानम् . देव्यास्तनययोगापनोदनाय शम्भोः सुरतविरतये देवानां प्रार्थना . देवानां तुष्ट्यर्थ शम्भुना चिरसन्धारितस्य स्वतेजसो वह्नावाधानम् . महासुरतभङ्गात् पार्वत्याः प्रकोपः . नन्दिनं प्रति रोषेण कर्णोत्पलप्रक्षेपः . ततः स्वर्णशृंगसमीपतो भद्रोत्पलसरोत्पत्तिः . देवताभ्यः पार्वत्याः शापः . कैटभ नाम्ना पार्वत्यास्तत्रावस्थानम् . रमणशिलामहिमा, शङ्करसकाशे देवानामन्धकतपःप्रवृत्तिविज्ञापनम् . शंकरेण देवानां समाश्वासनम्, शंकराज्ञया माहेश्वतेजसौ देवैः शरवणे समुत्सर्जनम् . तत्प्रभावात् तत्र सर्वस्य हिरण्मयीभावः .
7.20.m: The God of gods, sporting on Mandara, coming to Mount Vindhya at the request of Pārvatī, and there, having concentrated through yoga in a great city created by his mind, beginning great amorous dalliance with her. The gods, terrified upon seeing great portents caused by that, coming to the Vindhya and sending Fire as an invisible envoy into his presence to see Śaṃkara. Fire's entry inside there through the favor of Nandin. At Fire's petition, the God of gods silently emerging from the great amorous dalliance and granting a vision to the gods. The gods' petition for Śambhu's cessation from lovemaking in order to avert the union that would produce a son for the goddess. Śambhu depositing his brilliance, which had been held for a long time, into Fire for the satisfaction of the gods. Pārvatī's intense fury over the disruption of the great amorous dalliance. Her throwing of an ear-lotus in anger at Nandin. From that, the arising of the Bhadrotpala lake near Svarṇaśṛṅga. Pārvatī's curse upon the deities. Pārvatī's residence there under the name Kaiṭabhā. The greatness of Ramaṇaśilā; the gods' report to Śaṅkara of Andhaka's undertaking of austerities. The consolation of the gods by Śaṃkara; the discharge of Śiva's brilliance into the reed-thicket by the gods at Śaṃkara's command. Everything there turning to gold through its power.
73 In the seventy-third chapter—

7.20.s: andhakotpattikathāmavatārayituṃ prasaṃgāt śaṃkukarṇakṣetrasamākhyānam . putraprāptyartha śaṃkukarṇakṣetre hiraṇyākṣasya tapaścaryā . parihāsārthaṃ pārvatyā śambhornetranimīlanam . śabhunetranimīlanajanyāndhakārād andhakotpattiḥ . tapaścarate hiraṇyākṣāya mahādevenāndhakasutapradānam . yuvāvasthāṃ prāptasyāndhakasya gṛhānnirgatya tapase prasthānam .
7.20.d: अन्धकोत्पत्तिकथामवतारयितुं प्रसंगात् शंकुकर्णक्षेत्रसमाख्यानम् . पुत्रप्राप्त्यर्थ शंकुकर्णक्षेत्रे हिरण्याक्षस्य तपश्चर्या . परिहासार्थं पार्वत्या शम्भोर्नेत्रनिमीलनम् . शभुनेत्रनिमीलनजन्यान्धकाराद् अन्धकोत्पत्तिः . तपश्चरते हिरण्याक्षाय महादेवेनान्धकसुतप्रदानम् . युवावस्थां प्राप्तस्यान्धकस्य गृहान्निर्गत्य तपसे प्रस्थानम् .
7.20.m: In order to introduce the story of the birth of Andhaka, the description of the sacred field of Śaṅkukarṇa in this connection. The practice of austerity by Hiraṇyākṣa in the sacred field of Śaṅkukarṇa for obtaining a son. The covering of Śambhu's eyes by Pārvatī in jest. The birth of Andhaka from the darkness caused by the covering of Śambhu's eyes. The granting of the son Andhaka by Mahādeva to Hiraṇyākṣa as he performed austerity. Andhaka, having reached youth, departs from home to perform austerity.
74. In the seventy-fourth chapter:
The practice of austerity by Andhaka in the Kanakhala sacred field situated at Gaṅgādvāra, the obtaining of a boon from Brahmā, and the gaining of eyesight.
75. In the seventy-fifth chapter:
The return home of Andhaka after receiving the boon. The long-contemplated great Kaumudī festival celebrated by Hiraṇyākṣa.
76. In the seventy-sixth chapter:

7.20.s: hiraṇyākṣapure dānavānāṃ mahāsamājaḥ, daityadānavānāṃ sabhāpraveśaḥ, hiraṇyākṣasya sabhāpraveśaḥ .
7.20.d: हिरण्याक्षपुरे दानवानां महासमाजः, दैत्यदानवानां सभाप्रवेशः, हिरण्याक्षस्य सभाप्रवेशः .
7.20.m: The great assembly of Dānavas in Hiraṇyākṣa's city, the entry of the Daityas and Dānavas into the assembly hall, and the entry of Hiraṇyākṣa into the assembly hall.
77. In the seventy-seventh chapter:

7.20.s: daityadānavavīrāṇāṃ parāmarśaḥ, vijayayātrāprastāvaḥ, hiraṇyākṣasya sainyasannāhaḥ, śukravākyam . śukraṃ puraskṛtya sasainyasya hiraṇyākṣasya amarāvatīvijayāya niryāṇam .
7.20.d: दैत्यदानववीराणां परामर्शः, विजययात्राप्रस्तावः, हिरण्याक्षस्य सैन्यसन्नाहः, शुक्रवाक्यम् . शुक्रं पुरस्कृत्य ससैन्यस्य हिरण्याक्षस्य अमरावतीविजयाय निर्याणम् .
7.20.m: Deliberation of the Daitya and Dānava warriors, the proposal for a campaign of conquest, Hiraṇyākṣa's mobilization of the army, and the speech of Śukra. Setting out of Hiraṇyākṣa along with his army, placing Śukra in front, to conquer Amarāvatī.
78. In the seventy-eighth chapter:

7.20.s: amarāvatyāṃ devānāṃ bhayasūcakā dāruṇotpātāḥ, bṛhaspativākyam, devānāṃ sainyasannāhaḥ, vyūharacanā, yuddhāya niryāṇam .
7.20.d: अमरावत्यां देवानां भयसूचका दारुणोत्पाताः, बृहस्पतिवाक्यम्, देवानां सैन्यसन्नाहः, व्यूहरचना, युद्धाय निर्याणम् .
7.20.m: Terrible omens portending danger to the gods in Amarāvatī, the speech of Bṛhaspati, the gods' mobilization of forces, the formation of battle arrays, and the march out to war.
79. In the seventy-ninth chapter:

7.20.s: daityapakṣe vyūharacanā, yuddhārasbhaḥ devadānavasainyānāṃ bhīṣaṇaḥ saṃgharṣaḥ .
7.20.d: दैत्यपक्षे व्यूहरचना, युद्धारस्भः देवदानवसैन्यानां भीषणः संघर्षः .
7.20.m: Formation of battle arrays on the Daitya side, the start of the battle, and the dreadful clash between the armies of the gods and the Dānavas.
80. In the eightieth chapter:

7.20.s: lokapālānāṃ daityadānavavīraiḥ saha dāruṇaṃ yuddham . daityadānavavīrāṇāṃ parākramaḥ .
7.20.d: लोकपालानां दैत्यदानववीरैः सह दारुणं युद्धम् . दैत्यदानववीराणां पराक्रमः .
7.20.m: A terrible battle of the guardians of the world with the Daitya and Dānava warriors. The prowess of the Daitya and Dānava warriors.
81. In the eighty-first chapter:
The battle between the king of the gods and Hiraṇyākṣa. The prowess of the Āditya named Aṃśa.
82. In the eighty-second chapter:

7.20.s: devadānavavīrāṇāṃ tumulaṃ yuddham . daityadānavavīrāṇāṃ yuddhasthalādvidravaṇam hiraṇyākṣavākyādvīrāṇāṃ palāyanānni- vṛttiḥ .
7.20.d: देवदानववीराणां तुमुलं युद्धम् . दैत्यदानववीराणां युद्धस्थलाद्विद्रवणम् हिरण्याक्षवाक्याद्वीराणां पलायनान्नि- वृत्तिः .
7.20.m: A tumultuous battle between the warriors of the gods and Dānavas. The flight of the Daitya and Dānava warriors from the battlefield, and the warriors' halting their flight at the words of Hiraṇyākṣa.
83. In the eighty-third chapter:

7.20.s: devadānavavīrāṇāṃ punastumulayuddhārambhaḥ . saṃkulaṃ yuddham, ubhayoḥ pakṣayormahat kadanam .
7.20.d: देवदानववीराणां पुनस्तुमुलयुद्धारम्भः . संकुलं युद्धम्, उभयोः पक्षयोर्महत् कदनम् .
7.20.m: The resumption of tumultuous battle between the warriors of the gods and Dānavas. Confused fighting, and great slaughter on both sides.
84. In the eighty-fourth chapter:

7.20.s: devadānavayuddhasya mahāyajñarūpeṇa varṇanam, devānāṃ dānavānāñca bhīṣaṇaḥ saṃgharṣaḥ, dāruṇaṃ dvandvayuddham, devendrahiraṇyākṣayo- ryuddham, airāvatasya vikramaḥ . hiraṇyākṣakṛtaprahāreṇa saśakrasyairāvatasya yuddhabhūmervidravaṇam .
7.20.d: देवदानवयुद्धस्य महायज्ञरूपेण वर्णनम्, देवानां दानवानाञ्च भीषणः संघर्षः, दारुणं द्वन्द्वयुद्धम्, देवेन्द्रहिरण्याक्षयो- र्युद्धम्, ऐरावतस्य विक्रमः . हिरण्याक्षकृतप्रहारेण सशक्रस्यैरावतस्य युद्धभूमेर्विद्रवणम् .
7.20.m: The depiction of the battle between gods and Dānavas in the form of a great sacrifice, the dreadful clash of gods and Dānavas, fierce single combats, the fight between the lord of the gods and Hiraṇyākṣa, and the valor of Airāvata. The fleeing of Airāvata, carrying Śakra, from the battlefield under the blow struck by Hiraṇyākṣa.
85. In the eighty-fifth chapter:

7.20.s: vāyuvipracittyoraṃśasaṃvarayorbhagabalayoḥ pūṣavirocanayośca dvandvayuddhavarṇanam . vāyvaṃśabhagānāṃ parājayaḥ, pūṣṇaḥ parākramaḥ .
7.20.d: वायुविप्रचित्त्योरंशसंवरयोर्भगबलयोः पूषविरोचनयोश्च द्वन्द्वयुद्धवर्णनम् . वाय्वंशभगानां पराजयः, पूष्णः पराक्रमः .
7.20.m: Description of the duels between Vāyu and Vipracitti, Aṃśa and Saṃvara, Bhaga and Bala, and Pūṣan and Virocana. The defeat of Vāyu, Aṃśa, and Bhaga; the prowess of Pūṣan.
86. In the eighty-sixth chapter:
The defeat of Pūṣan, duels between Bali and Mitra, Bāṇa and Varuṇa, Yama and Andhaka, and Jayanta and Ilvala. The vanquishing of Mitra, Varuṇa, Yama, and Jayanta.
87. In the eighty-seventh chapter:
Single combats between Maya and the Moon, Rāhu and Ahirbudhnya, Ajaikapād and Kālanemi, and Jvara and Kārtasvana.
88. In the eighty-eighth chapter:

7.20.s: aryamaprahlādayordharānuhrādayordvandvayuddham . tataḥ punardevagaṇānāṃ daityānāṃ ca saṃkulaṃ yuddham . devānāṃ balavadvegena dānavānāṃ balasya bhṛśaṃ vegapratighātaḥ .
7.20.d: अर्यमप्रह्लादयोर्धरानुह्रादयोर्द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् . ततः पुनर्देवगणानां दैत्यानां च संकुलं युद्धम् . देवानां बलवद्वेगेन दानवानां बलस्य भृशं वेगप्रतिघातः .
7.20.m: Single combat between Aryaman and Prahlāda, and between Dhara and Anuhrāda. Then again a tumultuous battle between the hosts of gods and Daityas. A severe check to the momentum of the Dānavas' army caused by the mighty onslaught of the gods.
89. In the eighty-ninth chapter:

7.20.s: dānavānāṃ trāṇāya hiraṇyākṣasya yuddhebhisaraṇam . hiraṇyākṣasya parākramaḥ, devānāṃ vidravaṇam, vāyorabhisaraṇam . vāyoḥ parākramaḥ, vāyuhiraṇyākṣayuddham, dānavavauraiḥ saha vāyoḥ saṃkulaṃ yuddham . vāyorvikramabhaṅgaḥ, sendrāṇāṃ devānāṃ punardānavān prati abhyākramaṇam . saṃkulaṃ yuddham, devendravirocanayoryuddham . virocanasya parākramaḥ, devānāṃ palāyanam .
7.20.d: दानवानां त्राणाय हिरण्याक्षस्य युद्धेभिसरणम् . हिरण्याक्षस्य पराक्रमः, देवानां विद्रवणम्, वायोरभिसरणम् . वायोः पराक्रमः, वायुहिरण्याक्षयुद्धम्, दानववौरैः सह वायोः संकुलं युद्धम् . वायोर्विक्रमभङ्गः, सेन्द्राणां देवानां पुनर्दानवान् प्रति अभ्याक्रमणम् . संकुलं युद्धम्, देवेन्द्रविरोचनयोर्युद्धम् . विरोचनस्य पराक्रमः, देवानां पलायनम् .
7.20.m: Hiraṇyākṣa's charge into the fray to protect the Dānavas. The prowess of Hiraṇyākṣa, the flight of the gods, and the advance of Vāyu. The prowess of Vāyu, the duel between Vāyu and Hiraṇyākṣa, and Vāyu's close fight with the Dānava warriors. The breaking of Vāyu's valor, the renewed counter-attack against the Dānavas by the gods headed by Indra. Tumultuous fighting, the combat between the lord of the gods and Virocana. The valor of Virocana, and the flight of the gods.
90. In the ninetieth chapter:

7.20.s: devasainyaṃ dānavavīrairardyamānaṃ samīkṣya agnīṣomayoryuddhebhisaraṇam . candramasaḥ śarāghātena hiraṇyākṣasya mohaḥ . sārathinā hiraṇyākṣasya saṃgrāmādapavāhanam . candramasaḥ parākramaḥ, daityavīrāṇāṃ stabdhībhāvaḥ, somenevāgnināpi daityasainyānāṃ bhṛśaṃ kadanam .
7.20.d: देवसैन्यं दानववीरैरर्द्यमानं समीक्ष्य अग्नीषोमयोर्युद्धेभिसरणम् . चन्द्रमसः शराघातेन हिरण्याक्षस्य मोहः . सारथिना हिरण्याक्षस्य संग्रामादपवाहनम् . चन्द्रमसः पराक्रमः, दैत्यवीराणां स्तब्धीभावः, सोमेनेवाग्निनापि दैत्यसैन्यानां भृशं कदनम् .
7.20.m: Seeing the army of the gods tormented by the Dānava warriors, Agni and Soma charge into battle. The fainting of Hiraṇyākṣa struck by the arrows of the Moon. Hiraṇyākṣa is carried away from the battle by his charioteer. The valor of the Moon, the stupefaction of the Daitya warriors, and the severe slaughter of the Daitya forces by Agni just as by Soma.
91. In the ninety-first chapter:

7.20.s: hiraṇyākṣakṛtā sārathibhartsanā . hiraṇyākṣasya punaryuddhabhūmau pratyāgamanam, hiraṇyākṣasyāgnīṣomābhyāṃ yuddham . somasya yuddhādapayānam .
7.20.d: हिरण्याक्षकृता सारथिभर्त्सना . हिरण्याक्षस्य पुनर्युद्धभूमौ प्रत्यागमनम्, हिरण्याक्षस्याग्नीषोमाभ्यां युद्धम् . सोमस्य युद्धादपयानम् .
7.20.m: The rebuke of the charioteer by Hiraṇyākṣa. Hiraṇyākṣa's return again to the field of battle, and the fight of Hiraṇyākṣa with Agni and Soma. Soma's retreat from the battle.
92. In the ninety-second chapter:

7.20.s: agnidānavayuddham, agneḥ parākramaḥ, agnimukhotthena dhūmena yuddhabhūmau sarvatrāndhakāraḥ, āṭibakasaṃjñaṃ bhṛśadāruṇamandha- kārayuddham .
7.20.d: अग्निदानवयुद्धम्, अग्नेः पराक्रमः, अग्निमुखोत्थेन धूमेन युद्धभूमौ सर्वत्रान्धकारः, आटिबकसंज्ञं भृशदारुणमन्ध- कारयुद्धम् .
7.20.m: The battle between Agni and the Dānavas, the valor of Agni, pervasive darkness on the battlefield caused by smoke rising from Agni's mouth, and the exceedingly terrible darkness-battle known as Āṭibaka.
93. In the ninety-third chapter:

7.20.s: andhakāravilayanam, śakrapurassarāṇāṃ devānāṃ prasabhaṃ daityasainyavimardanam, andhakāsuraparākramaḥ, devānāṃ palāyanam, daityānāmamarāvatīpraveśaḥ . hiraṇyākṣasya vijayātrārambhaḥ, varuṇalokāya prasthānam .
7.20.d: अन्धकारविलयनम्, शक्रपुरस्सराणां देवानां प्रसभं दैत्यसैन्यविमर्दनम्, अन्धकासुरपराक्रमः, देवानां पलायनम्, दैत्यानाममरावतीप्रवेशः . हिरण्याक्षस्य विजयात्रारम्भः, वरुणलोकाय प्रस्थानम् .
7.20.m: The dispersion of darkness, the violent crushing of the Daitya forces by the gods headed by Śakra, the prowess of the demon Andhaka, the flight of the gods, and the entry of the Daityas into Amarāvatī. The beginning of Hiraṇyākṣa's campaign of conquest, and his departure for the realm of Varuṇa.
94. In the ninety-fourth chapter:

7.20.s: (varuṇalokavijayaḥ), (yamalokābhigamanam, yamalokavijayaḥ), nārakīyāṇāṃ mokṣaṇam, pitṛpatitvena vipracitteḥ sthāpanam .
7.20.d: (वरुणलोकविजयः), (यमलोकाभिगमनम्, यमलोकविजयः), नारकीयाणां मोक्षणम्, पितृपतित्वेन विप्रचित्तेः स्थापनम् .
7.20.m: (Conquest of the realm of Varuṇa), (approach toward the realm of Yama, conquest of the realm of Yama), the liberation of the denizens of hell, and the installation of Vipracitti as the lord of the ancestors.
95. In the ninety-fifth chapter:

7.20.s: laṅkābhigamanam. yakṣapuryā laṅkāyā vaśīkaraṇam . laṅkāyāṃ prahlādasyābhiṣekaḥ, lokānāṃ vaśīkaraṇānantara devatānāṃ sthāneṣu dānaveśvarāṇāṃ sthāpanam . amarāvatyāmindratvenāndhakasyābhiṣecanam . svayaṃ hiraṇyākṣasyākhilabhūrlokā- nuśāsanam . mūrtimatīṃ pṛthivīṃ vaśīkṛtya nāgapāśairbaddhvā rasātale svapurasamīpatastasyāvarodhanam . hiraṇyākṣa- rājyavarṇanam .
7.20.d: लङ्काभिगमनम्. यक्षपुर्या लङ्काया वशीकरणम् . लङ्कायां प्रह्लादस्याभिषेकः, लोकानां वशीकरणानन्तर देवतानां स्थानेषु दानवेश्वराणां स्थापनम् . अमरावत्यामिन्द्रत्वेनान्धकस्याभिषेचनम् . स्वयं हिरण्याक्षस्याखिलभूर्लोका- नुशासनम् . मूर्तिमतीं पृथिवीं वशीकृत्य नागपाशैर्बद्ध्वा रसातले स्वपुरसमीपतस्तस्यावरोधनम् . हिरण्याक्ष- राज्यवर्णनम् .
7.20.m: March to Laṅkā. The subjugation of Laṅkā, the city of the Yakṣas. The consecration of Prahlāda in Laṅkā, the installation of lords among Dānavas in the places of the deities after subjugating the worlds. The consecration of Andhaka as Indra in Amarāvatī. Hiraṇyākṣa himself ruling over the entire realm of earth. Subjugating the personified Earth, binding her with serpent-nooses, and confining her in Rasātala near his own city. Description of Hiraṇyākṣa's reign.
96. In the ninety-sixth chapter:

7.20.s: devānāṃ duravasthā, brahmakṛtaṃ devānāṃ samāśvāsanam . brahmadattayogaprabhāveṇa devānāṃ prajāśarīreṣu nilīyāvasthānam . hiraṇyākṣasya atyācāraḥ .
7.20.d: देवानां दुरवस्था, ब्रह्मकृतं देवानां समाश्वासनम् . ब्रह्मदत्तयोगप्रभावेण देवानां प्रजाशरीरेषु निलीयावस्थानम् . हिरण्याक्षस्य अत्याचारः .
7.20.m: The plight of the gods, and the consolation offered to the gods by Brahmā. By the power of yoga granted by Brahmā, the gods' staying hidden within the bodies of living beings. The tyranny of Hiraṇyākṣa.
97. In the ninety-seventh chapter:

7.20.s: brahmaṇo vākyād devānāṃ śvetaparvatagamanam . tatra devaiḥ kṛtā viṣṇoḥ stutiḥ . hiraṇyākṣavināśāya prārthanā, sarvadevamayaṃ ( yajña) vārāhaśarīramāsthāyaiva tamugradaityaṃ haniṣyāmīti viṣṇunā devatānāṃ samāśvāsanam .
7.20.d: ब्रह्मणो वाक्याद् देवानां श्वेतपर्वतगमनम् . तत्र देवैः कृता विष्णोः स्तुतिः . हिरण्याक्षविनाशाय प्रार्थना, सर्वदेवमयं ( यज्ञ) वाराहशरीरमास्थायैव तमुग्रदैत्यं हनिष्यामीति विष्णुना देवतानां समाश्वासनम् .
7.20.m: At the word of Brahmā, the gods go to Mount Śveta. There, the gods praise Viṣṇu. Their petition for the destruction of Hiraṇyākṣa; Viṣṇu's reassuring of the deities, saying: 'Assuming a body of the Boar made of all the gods (the sacrifice), I shall slay that fierce Daitya.'
In the ninety-eighth chapter:

7.20.s: devairvarāharūpaprakalpanam, viṣṇunā varāhaśarīragrahaṇam . varāharūpasya viṣṇoraṅgapratyaṅgeṣu devādīnāmavasthiti- varṇanam . ṛṣibhirvarāhatejasaḥ samuddīpanam . varāhasya devānprati vacanam, mahādevena devānāṃ samāśvāsanam . brahmaṇā kṛtarakṣāvidhervarāhasya rudraṃ namaskṛtya varuṇālayaṃ prati prasthānam .
7.20.d: देवैर्वराहरूपप्रकल्पनम्, विष्णुना वराहशरीरग्रहणम् . वराहरूपस्य विष्णोरङ्गप्रत्यङ्गेषु देवादीनामवस्थिति- वर्णनम् . ऋषिभिर्वराहतेजसः समुद्दीपनम् . वराहस्य देवान्प्रति वचनम्, महादेवेन देवानां समाश्वासनम् . ब्रह्मणा कृतरक्षाविधेर्वराहस्य रुद्रं नमस्कृत्य वरुणालयं प्रति प्रस्थानम् .
7.20.m: The gods' fashioning of the Boar form; Viṣṇu's assuming the body of the Boar. The description of the gods and others abiding in the limbs and parts of Viṣṇu in the form of the Boar. The rekindling of the Boar's splendor by the seers. The Boar's speech to the gods; Mahādeva's reassuring of the gods. The Boar, for whom the rite of protection was performed by Brahmā, bows to Rudra and departs toward the abode of Varuṇa.
In the ninety-ninth chapter:

7.20.s: varāhasya mahārṇavapraveśaḥ, antaḥsamudre kramāllokāllokāntaraṃ gacchato varāhasya rasātalaprāptiḥ, hiraṇyākṣāya varāhāgamanaṃ nivedayituṃ sāgarapālasya dānavasya aśmakapuraṃ prati gamanam .
7.20.d: वराहस्य महार्णवप्रवेशः, अन्तःसमुद्रे क्रमाल्लोकाल्लोकान्तरं गच्छतो वराहस्य रसातलप्राप्तिः, हिरण्याक्षाय वराहागमनं निवेदयितुं सागरपालस्य दानवस्य अश्मकपुरं प्रति गमनम् .
7.20.m: The Boar enters the great ocean; the Boar, going gradually from world to world within the ocean, reaches Rasātala; the ocean-guarding Dānava goes to the city of Aśmakapura to inform Hiraṇyākṣa of the Boar's arrival.
In the one hundredth chapter:

7.20.s: hiraṇyākṣapure bhayaṅkarā utpātā, prahlādahiraṇyākṣayoraniṣṭasvapnadarśanam . daityānāṃ vimarśaḥ, bhītasya sāgarapālasya sasaṃbhramaṃ sabhāpraveśaḥ . tatkṛtaṃ varāhasvarūpavarṇanam . varāhapravṛttivijñānāya hiraṇyākṣeṇa kiṅkaragaṇapreṣaṇam .
7.20.d: हिरण्याक्षपुरे भयङ्करा उत्पाता, प्रह्लादहिरण्याक्षयोरनिष्टस्वप्नदर्शनम् . दैत्यानां विमर्शः, भीतस्य सागरपालस्य ससंभ्रमं सभाप्रवेशः . तत्कृतं वराहस्वरूपवर्णनम् . वराहप्रवृत्तिविज्ञानाय हिरण्याक्षेण किङ्करगणप्रेषणम् .
7.20.m: Terrifying portents in the city of Hiraṇyākṣa; Prahlāda and Hiraṇyākṣa see bad dreams. The deliberation of the Daityas; the terrified ocean-guard enters the assembly hall in haste. His description of the Boar's appearance. Hiraṇyākṣa sends a host of servants to learn of the Boar's activities.
In the one hundred and first chapter:

7.20.s: kiṅkarāṇāṃ varāhasandarśanam . varāhakiṅkarasaṃvādaḥ, kiṅkarāṇāṃ varāhaṃ prati śastrakūṭaiḥ praharaṇam . varāheṇa kiṅkarāṇāṃ niḥśeṣatayā kadanam .
7.20.d: किङ्कराणां वराहसन्दर्शनम् . वराहकिङ्करसंवादः, किङ्कराणां वराहं प्रति शस्त्रकूटैः प्रहरणम् . वराहेण किङ्कराणां निःशेषतया कदनम् .
7.20.m: The servants see the Boar. The dialogue between the Boar and the servants; the servants strike at the Boar with masses of weapons. The Boar completely slaughters the servants.
In the one hundred and second chapter:

7.20.s: kiṅkarāṇāṃ kadanaṃ śrutvā bhṛśaṃ kruddhasya hiraṇyākṣasya svāsanādutpatanam . vipracicittiprabhṛtibhirdānavaiḥ samāśvāsanam . hiraṇyākṣasyājñayā prahlādādipramukhavīrāṇāṃ varāhanigrahārthaṃ niryāṇam . kiṅkaragaṇānnipātyāśmakapura prāptena varāheṇa puradvārādividhvaṃsanam . saśastravarṣaṃ dānavavīrairanuyātasya varāhasya purāda bahiḥ samāṃ bhūmimupāśritya yodhanam .
7.20.d: किङ्कराणां कदनं श्रुत्वा भृशं क्रुद्धस्य हिरण्याक्षस्य स्वासनादुत्पतनम् . विप्रचिचित्तिप्रभृतिभिर्दानवैः समाश्वासनम् . हिरण्याक्षस्याज्ञया प्रह्लादादिप्रमुखवीराणां वराहनिग्रहार्थं निर्याणम् . किङ्करगणान्निपात्याश्मकपुर प्राप्तेन वराहेण पुरद्वारादिविध्वंसनम् . सशस्त्रवर्षं दानववीरैरनुयातस्य वराहस्य पुराद बहिः समां भूमिमुपाश्रित्य योधनम् .
7.20.m: Hearing of the slaughter of his servants, Hiraṇyākṣa becomes exceedingly enraged and leaps from his seat. He is consoled by Vipracitti and other Dānavas. By Hiraṇyākṣa's order, prominent heroes headed by Prahlāda set forth to subdue the Boar. Striking down the host of servants, the Boar reaches Aśmakapura and destroys the city gates and other structures. Followed by the Dānava heroes showering weapons, the Boar fights outside the city, taking his stand on level ground.
In the one hundred and third chapter:

7.20.s: varāhasya prahlādāndhakavipracittyādibhirdānavavīraiḥ saha subhīṣaṇaṃ citrayuddham . tathā yudhyatā varāheṇa nikhila- dānavānāṃ vidrāvaṇam .
7.20.d: वराहस्य प्रह्लादान्धकविप्रचित्त्यादिभिर्दानववीरैः सह सुभीषणं चित्रयुद्धम् . तथा युध्यता वराहेण निखिल- दानवानां विद्रावणम् .
7.20.m: A most terrifying and wonderful battle between the Boar and heroic Dānavas such as Prahlāda, Andhaka, and Vipracitti. Fighting thus, the Boar puts all the Dānavas to flight.
In the one hundred and fourth chapter:

7.20.s: dānavaiḥ punarvarāhaṃ prati śastravarṣaṇam . dānavaprahitasarvaśastrāṇāṃ varāheṇa grasanam . dānavaiḥ saha varāhasya bhīṣaṇa yuddham . varāheṇa nikhiladānavānāṃ vidrāvaṇam . nardatā varāheṇa vipracittiṃ bhrāmayitvā tasya puraṃ prati protkṣepaṇam . vipracitterhiraṇyākṣabhavanopari vegena nipatanam . hiraṇyākṣeṇa vipracitteḥ samāśvāsanam . vipracittihiraṇyākṣa- saṃvādaḥ . vipracitternairāśyavacanam, hiraṇyākṣasya svayaṃ yuddhāya gantuṃ niścayaḥ .
7.20.d: दानवैः पुनर्वराहं प्रति शस्त्रवर्षणम् . दानवप्रहितसर्वशस्त्राणां वराहेण ग्रसनम् . दानवैः सह वराहस्य भीषण युद्धम् . वराहेण निखिलदानवानां विद्रावणम् . नर्दता वराहेण विप्रचित्तिं भ्रामयित्वा तस्य पुरं प्रति प्रोत्क्षेपणम् . विप्रचित्तेर्हिरण्याक्षभवनोपरि वेगेन निपतनम् . हिरण्याक्षेण विप्रचित्तेः समाश्वासनम् . विप्रचित्तिहिरण्याक्ष- संवादः . विप्रचित्तेर्नैराश्यवचनम्, हिरण्याक्षस्य स्वयं युद्धाय गन्तुं निश्चयः .
7.20.m: The Dānavas shower weapons upon the Boar once more. The Boar devours all the weapons hurled by the Dānavas. A terrifying battle between the Boar and the Dānavas. The Boar puts all the Dānavas to flight. Roaring, the Boar spins Vipracitti around and hurls him toward the city. Vipracitti falls with force upon the palace of Hiraṇyākṣa. Hiraṇyākṣa consoles Vipracitti. The dialogue between Vipracitti and Hiraṇyākṣa. Vipracitti's words of despair; Hiraṇyākṣa's resolution to go to battle himself.
In the one hundred and fifth chapter:

7.20.s: kruddhasya hiraṇyākṣasyātimahatā rathena yuddhāya niryāṇam . yuddhārthaṃ purānnirgacchato hiraṇyākṣasya nānāvidhamahotpāta- darśanam . varāhahiraṇyākṣayuddham . hiraṇyākṣaśarāghātena niścoṣṭasya varāhasya maharṣibhirdevatābhiśca svatejobhiḥ samāpyāyanam .
7.20.d: क्रुद्धस्य हिरण्याक्षस्यातिमहता रथेन युद्धाय निर्याणम् . युद्धार्थं पुरान्निर्गच्छतो हिरण्याक्षस्य नानाविधमहोत्पात- दर्शनम् . वराहहिरण्याक्षयुद्धम् . हिरण्याक्षशराघातेन निश्चोष्टस्य वराहस्य महर्षिभिर्देवताभिश्च स्वतेजोभिः समाप्यायनम् .
7.20.m: Enraged, Hiraṇyākṣa sets forth for battle in an enormous chariot. Departing from the city for the fight, Hiraṇyākṣa witnesses diverse great portents. The battle between the Boar and Hiraṇyākṣa. The Boar, rendered motionless by the strike of Hiraṇyākṣa's arrows, is reinvigorated with their own splenders by the great seers and the deities.
In the one hundred and sixth chapter:

7.20.s: taistathāpyāyanādūrjitatejaso varāhasya punarhiraṇyākṣeṇa saha bhīṣaṇaṃ yuddham . varāhahiraṇyākṣayoḥ parasparamākṣepaḥ . dāruṇaṃ yuddham, kruddhasya hiraṇyākṣasya varāhaṃ prati bhīṣaṇaśūlaprakṣepaḥ .
7.20.d: तैस्तथाप्यायनादूर्जिततेजसो वराहस्य पुनर्हिरण्याक्षेण सह भीषणं युद्धम् . वराहहिरण्याक्षयोः परस्परमाक्षेपः . दारुणं युद्धम्, क्रुद्धस्य हिरण्याक्षस्य वराहं प्रति भीषणशूलप्रक्षेपः .
7.20.m: His splendor bolstered by being reinvigorated by them in this way, the Boar once again fights a terrifying battle with Hiraṇyākṣa. Mutual recriminations between the Boar and Hiraṇyākṣa. A dreadful battle; the enraged Hiraṇyākṣa hurls a terrifying spear at the Boar.
In the one hundred and seventh chapter:

7.20.s: alakṣitena vegavatā śūlena hṛdi viddhasya varāhasya nisaṃjñatayā bhūmau nipatanam . jagati nānāvidhamahotpātapravṛttiḥ, brahmādibhiḥ prārthitena mahādevena svatejasā varāhāpyāyanam . tathāpyāyitasya kṛcchrānmuktasya varāhasya hiraṇyākṣeṇa bahukālaṃ yuddham . prāptakālānatikramaṇārthaṃ varāhaṃ pratyākāśavāṇī, varāhakṛto hiraṇyākṣavadhaḥ .
7.20.d: अलक्षितेन वेगवता शूलेन हृदि विद्धस्य वराहस्य निसंज्ञतया भूमौ निपतनम् . जगति नानाविधमहोत्पातप्रवृत्तिः, ब्रह्मादिभिः प्रार्थितेन महादेवेन स्वतेजसा वराहाप्यायनम् . तथाप्यायितस्य कृच्छ्रान्मुक्तस्य वराहस्य हिरण्याक्षेण बहुकालं युद्धम् . प्राप्तकालानतिक्रमणार्थं वराहं प्रत्याकाशवाणी, वराहकृतो हिरण्याक्षवधः .
7.20.m: Pierced in the chest by the unseen, swift spear, the Boar falls unconscious to the earth. Diverse great portents arise throughout the world; petitioned by Brahmā and others, Mahādeva reinvigorates the Boar with his own splendor. Thus reinvigorated and freed from distress, the Boar fights Hiraṇyākṣa for a long time. A voice from the sky addresses the Boar so that the opportune moment is not missed; the slaying of Hiraṇyākṣa performed by the Boar.
In the one hundred and eighth chapter:

7.20.s: varāheṇāntaḥ samudre pṛthivyā anveṣaṇam bandhanādunmocananam, rasātalādānīya svasthāne sthāpanaṃ ca. tato devakṛtai- rdivyotsavairnandato varāhasya mṛgīrūpeṇopasthitābhirdivyāpsarobhiḥ saha suciraṃ bhūrloka eva krīḍāviharaṇenāva- syānam .
7.20.d: वराहेणान्तः समुद्रे पृथिव्या अन्वेषणम् बन्धनादुन्मोचननम्, रसातलादानीय स्वस्थाने स्थापनं च. ततो देवकृतै- र्दिव्योत्सवैर्नन्दतो वराहस्य मृगीरूपेणोपस्थिताभिर्दिव्याप्सरोभिः सह सुचिरं भूर्लोक एव क्रीडाविहरणेनाव- स्यानम् .
7.20.m: The Boar searches for the earth within the ocean, frees her from bondage, and brings her up from Rasātala to establish her in her proper place. Then, delighted by the divine celebrations performed by the gods, the Boar abides for a long time in the earthly realm alone, sporting and wandering in play with divine apsarases who have appeared in the form of female deer.
In the one hundred and ninth chapter:

7.20.s: tathā ramamāṇasya varāhasya citralekhābhāryāyāṃ vṛkanāmnaḥ putrasyotpattiḥ . yadṛcchayā pṛthivyāṃ vicarato vṛkasya himavacchikhare kumārānupasthitau tadālayamāsādya baladarpādudyānadrumabhañjanam . kokāmukhanāmnā kumārānucareṇa vṛkasya bandhanam . nāradamukhāttadvijñāya varāhasya sasaṃbhramaṃ kumāragṛhagamanam .
7.20.d: तथा रममाणस्य वराहस्य चित्रलेखाभार्यायां वृकनाम्नः पुत्रस्योत्पत्तिः . यदृच्छया पृथिव्यां विचरतो वृकस्य हिमवच्छिखरे कुमारानुपस्थितौ तदालयमासाद्य बलदर्पादुद्यानद्रुमभञ्जनम् . कोकामुखनाम्ना कुमारानुचरेण वृकस्य बन्धनम् . नारदमुखात्तद्विज्ञाय वराहस्य ससंभ्रमं कुमारगृहगमनम् .
7.20.m: To the Boar thus sporting, a son named Vṛka is born through his wife Citralekhā. Wandering at will over the earth, Vṛka approaches Kumāra's abode on the peak of the Himālaya in Kumāra's absence, and out of arrogant pride in his strength breaks the trees of the garden. Kumāra's attendant named Kokāmukha binds Vṛka. Learning of this from the mouth of Nārada, the Boar hastily goes to Kumāra's house.
In the one hundred and tenth chapter:

7.20.s: kumāreṇa saha varāhasya yuddham . kumāraśaktiprahārato varāhasya dehāvapātaḥ . varāhaśarīrādunmuktena viṣṇunā kṛtā śaṃkarastutiḥ. pāśupatavratopadeśārthaṃ prārthanā ca . devatābhyo vratopadeśārthaṃ śambhordevaiḥ saha dyulokagamanam .
7.20.d: कुमारेण सह वराहस्य युद्धम् . कुमारशक्तिप्रहारतो वराहस्य देहावपातः . वराहशरीरादुन्मुक्तेन विष्णुना कृता शंकरस्तुतिः. पाशुपतव्रतोपदेशार्थं प्रार्थना च . देवताभ्यो व्रतोपदेशार्थं शम्भोर्देवैः सह द्युलोकगमनम् .
7.20.m: The battle of the Boar with Kumāra. By a strike of Kumāra's lance, the Boar's body collapses. Released from the body of the Boar, Viṣṇu offers praise to Śaṃkara. And his prayer for instruction in the Pāśupata observance. To instruct the deities in the observance, Śambhu goes to heaven along with the gods.
In the one hundred and eleventh chapter:

7.20.s: śambhau vratopadeśārthaṃ dyulokaṃ gate lokamātṝṇāṃ devīnāmṛṣipatnīnāṃ devayakṣoragagandharvādipatnīnāṃ ca dharmajijñāsayā pārvatīsamīpa āgamanam . tābhyaḥ pārvatyā dharmopadeśaḥ . annādidānamahimā, prapākūpataḍāgādikaraṇamahimā, vṛkṣaropaṇādimahimā, kāñcanabhūmyādidānamahimā, śayyopakaraṇa vastrabhājanādidānamahimā, kanyādānamahimā, gṛhagajarathā'vādidānamahimā, vividhadhenudānamahimā, godānamahimā, gavāmaṅgavarttināṃ devādīnāṃ varṇanam . jala- pātrādidānamahimā, asahāyadīnamūḍhavyādhitasāhāyyakaraṇamahimavarṇanam . daridrāya viprāya suvarṇadānasya phala- kathanam .
7.20.d: शम्भौ व्रतोपदेशार्थं द्युलोकं गते लोकमातॄणां देवीनामृषिपत्नीनां देवयक्षोरगगन्धर्वादिपत्नीनां च धर्मजिज्ञासया पार्वतीसमीप आगमनम् . ताभ्यः पार्वत्या धर्मोपदेशः . अन्नादिदानमहिमा, प्रपाकूपतडागादिकरणमहिमा, वृक्षरोपणादिमहिमा, काञ्चनभूम्यादिदानमहिमा, शय्योपकरण वस्त्रभाजनादिदानमहिमा, कन्यादानमहिमा, गृहगजरथाऽवादिदानमहिमा, विविधधेनुदानमहिमा, गोदानमहिमा, गवामङ्गवर्त्तिनां देवादीनां वर्णनम् . जल- पात्रादिदानमहिमा, असहायदीनमूढव्याधितसाहाय्यकरणमहिमवर्णनम् . दरिद्राय विप्राय सुवर्णदानस्य फल- कथनम् .
7.20.m: When Śambhu went to heaven to teach the religious vow, the mothers of the world, the goddesses, the wives of the seers, and the wives of gods, yakṣas, serpents, gandharvas, and others came to Pārvatī desiring to know dharma. The teaching of dharma given to them by Pārvatī. The greatness of giving food and other gifts; the greatness of constructing water-booths, wells, ponds, and the like; the greatness of planting trees and similar deeds; the greatness of gifting gold, land, and so forth; the greatness of gifting beds, household articles, garments, vessels, and the like; the greatness of giving a daughter in marriage; the greatness of gifting houses, elephants, chariots, horses, and the like; the greatness of gifting various kinds of cows; the greatness of the gift of cows; description of the gods and other beings abiding in the limbs of cows. The greatness of gifting water vessels and the like; description of the greatness of rendering assistance to the helpless, the wretched, the foolish, and the sick. The statement of the fruit of gifting gold to a poor brahmin.
112. In the one hundred and twelfth chapter:

7.20.s: ekabhaktopavāsakṛcchracāndrāyaṇādivividhavratavidhivarṇanam . strīṇāṃ bhartranujñayaiva dharmācaraṇādāvadhikāra iti kathanam . pārvatyā devamātṛbhiḥ saha mandare vanadidṛkṣayā bhramaṇam . tatra pārvatyā puṣpitāśokatarupotakadarśanam . bālāśokadarśanājjātasnehāyāḥ pārvatyā hṛdi tasya putratvena grahaṇābhilāṣaḥ, tadantare sagaṇasyāndhakasya pātālāda- bhyetya mandarācale gamanam . tatra tasya pārvatīdarśanānmanaḥkṣobhaḥ, tadvijñāya pārvatyā dūrata eva tatonyatra gamanam . jaganmātuḥ pārvatyā anavamānārthamandhakāya prahlādasyopadeśaḥ, mandare saptarṣīṇāṃ dhātrādibhiḥ samāgamaḥ, teṣāṃ yathā- śrutāmṛtamathanetivṛttakathanam .
7.20.d: एकभक्तोपवासकृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिविविधव्रतविधिवर्णनम् . स्त्रीणां भर्त्रनुज्ञयैव धर्माचरणादावधिकार इति कथनम् . पार्वत्या देवमातृभिः सह मन्दरे वनदिदृक्षया भ्रमणम् . तत्र पार्वत्या पुष्पिताशोकतरुपोतकदर्शनम् . बालाशोकदर्शनाज्जातस्नेहायाः पार्वत्या हृदि तस्य पुत्रत्वेन ग्रहणाभिलाषः, तदन्तरे सगणस्यान्धकस्य पातालाद- भ्येत्य मन्दराचले गमनम् . तत्र तस्य पार्वतीदर्शनान्मनःक्षोभः, तद्विज्ञाय पार्वत्या दूरत एव ततोन्यत्र गमनम् . जगन्मातुः पार्वत्या अनवमानार्थमन्धकाय प्रह्लादस्योपदेशः, मन्दरे सप्तर्षीणां धात्रादिभिः समागमः, तेषां यथा- श्रुतामृतमथनेतिवृत्तकथनम् .
7.20.m: Description of the rules for various vows such as eating once a day, fasting, the kṛcchra, and the cāndrāyaṇa penances. The statement that women are entitled to practice dharma and related duties only with their husband's permission. Pārvatī's wandering with the mothers of the gods on Mount Mandara out of a desire to see the forest. There, Pārvatī sees a young sapling of an aśoka tree in bloom. From seeing the tender aśoka tree, affection arises in Pārvatī, and the desire to take it as a son awakens in her heart. Meanwhile, Andhaka, accompanied by his host, emerges from Pātāla and comes to Mount Mandara. There, upon seeing Pārvatī, his mind becomes agitated; perceiving this from afar, Pārvatī departs to another place. Prahlāda's instruction to Andhaka not to insult Pārvatī, the mother of the world. The meeting of the Seven Seers with Dhātṛ and the others on Mandara; their narration of the events of the churning for the nectar of immortality just as they had heard them.
113. In the one hundred and thirteenth chapter:

7.20.s: brahmaṇa upadeśād devāsurakṛtaṃ samudramathanam . tadutthograviṣasya śaṅkareṇa pānam, amṛtotpattiḥ, asurairamṛtāpaharaṇam . viṣṇunā mohinīrūpamāsthāya māyayā'surānmohayitvā'mṛtaṃ pragṛhya tasya devebhyaḥ pradānam .
7.20.d: ब्रह्मण उपदेशाद् देवासुरकृतं समुद्रमथनम् . तदुत्थोग्रविषस्य शङ्करेण पानम्, अमृतोत्पत्तिः, असुरैरमृतापहरणम् . विष्णुना मोहिनीरूपमास्थाय माययाऽसुरान्मोहयित्वाऽमृतं प्रगृह्य तस्य देवेभ्यः प्रदानम् .
7.20.m: The churning of the ocean performed by the gods and asuras following the instruction of Brahmā. The swallowing of the dread poison that arose from it by Śaṅkara; the emergence of the nectar of immortality; the stealing of the nectar of immortality by the asuras. Viṣṇu, assuming the form of Mohinī, bewitches the asuras by his illusory power, takes the nectar of immortality, and gives it to the gods.
114. In the one hundred and fourteenth chapter:

7.20.s: kālakūṭaviṣasyotpattervistareṇa varṇanārthaṃ mahādevasya nīlakaṇṭhatāsamākhyānārthaṃ ca sanatkumāraṃ prati vyāsasyā- nurodhaḥ , kathāprasaṃgena vāyubālakhilyasaṃvādasya kumāravasiṣṭhasaṃvādasyomāmaheśvarasaṃvādasya cāvatāraṇam . umayā pṛṣṭena mahādevena svasya nīlakaṇṭhatāyā itivṛttaṃ kathayituṃ kālakūṭotpattervistareṇa varṇanam . samudramanthanotpannāt kālakūṭājjagatastrāṇārthaṃ brahmakṛtā bhavastutiḥ . brahmaṇaḥ prārthanayā surāsurasaṃghānāṃ savismayaṃ paśyatāṃ mayā lokatrayahitāya tadugraviṣaṃ nipīya kaṇṭhe dhṛtaṃ, tataśceyaṃ śrīkaṇṭhatā mameti mahādevo pārvatyai svasya nīlakaṇṭhatāyā itivṛttakathanam . brahmakṛtasya nijastavasya māhātmyavarṇanañca .
7.20.d: कालकूटविषस्योत्पत्तेर्विस्तरेण वर्णनार्थं महादेवस्य नीलकण्ठतासमाख्यानार्थं च सनत्कुमारं प्रति व्यासस्या- नुरोधः , कथाप्रसंगेन वायुबालखिल्यसंवादस्य कुमारवसिष्ठसंवादस्योमामहेश्वरसंवादस्य चावतारणम् . उमया पृष्टेन महादेवेन स्वस्य नीलकण्ठताया इतिवृत्तं कथयितुं कालकूटोत्पत्तेर्विस्तरेण वर्णनम् . समुद्रमन्थनोत्पन्नात् कालकूटाज्जगतस्त्राणार्थं ब्रह्मकृता भवस्तुतिः . ब्रह्मणः प्रार्थनया सुरासुरसंघानां सविस्मयं पश्यतां मया लोकत्रयहिताय तदुग्रविषं निपीय कण्ठे धृतं, ततश्चेयं श्रीकण्ठता ममेति महादेवो पार्वत्यै स्वस्य नीलकण्ठताया इतिवृत्तकथनम् . ब्रह्मकृतस्य निजस्तवस्य माहात्म्यवर्णनञ्च .
7.20.m: Vyāsa's request to Sanatkumāra to describe in detail the origin of the Kālakūṭa poison and to explain Mahādeva's epithet Nīlakaṇṭha. In the course of the story, the introduction of the dialogue between Vāyu and the Bālakhilyas, the dialogue between Kumāra and Vasiṣṭha, and the dialogue between Umā and Maheśvara. Asked by Umā, Mahādeva, in order to narrate the account of his own blue throat, describes in detail the origin of the Kālakūṭa. The praise of Bhava uttered by Brahmā to protect the world from the Kālakūṭa that arose from the churning of the ocean. Mahādeva narrates the account of his own blue throat to Pārvatī, saying: 'At the entreaty of Brahmā, while the hosts of gods and asuras looked on in wonder, I drank that dread poison and held it in my throat for the welfare of the three worlds, and hence this blue-throated state of mine arose.' And description of the māhātmya of the hymn in praise of himself composed by Brahmā.
115. In the one hundred and fifteenth chapter:

7.20.s: amṛtaharaṇottarasaṃjātadevāsurasaṃgrāmavarṇanam . yuddhe devairdānavānāṃ kadanam . devānāṃ vijayaḥ, prahlādapramukhānāṃ daityānāṃ yuddhātparāvartanam .
7.20.d: अमृतहरणोत्तरसंजातदेवासुरसंग्रामवर्णनम् . युद्धे देवैर्दानवानां कदनम् . देवानां विजयः, प्रह्लादप्रमुखानां दैत्यानां युद्धात्परावर्तनम् .
7.20.m: Description of the battle between the gods and asuras that arose after the theft of the nectar of immortality. The slaughter of the dānavas by the gods in battle. The victory of the gods; the retreat of the daityas led by Prahlāda from the battle.
116. In the one hundred and sixteenth chapter:

7.20.s: uttarottaraṃ yuddheṣu viṣṇunā parājitena prahlādena putrāya rājyapradānam . devāsurāṇāṃ varṣasahasrikamāṭivakākhyaṃ yuddham . tasmin yuddhe śakrakṛto virocanavadhaḥ . virocane hate brahmaṇā daityarājye balerabhiṣecanam . devān vijitya balinā trailokyarājyakaraṇam . viṣṇorvāmanāvatāraḥ, vāmanasya balisadmagamanam . balivāmanasaṃvādaḥ, baleḥ sakāśe vāmanasya padatrayonmitabhūmiyācanam . balau vāmanāya bhūmiṃ dātuṃ pravṛtte prahlādena niṣedhanam . vali- prahlādasaṃvādaḥ, prasaṃgād balikṛtana(ma?)ṣṭaketivṛttākhyānam . balinā vāmanāya saṃkalpya padatrayapradānam . balerupari sasādhuvādaṃ devaiḥ kṛtā puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ .
7.20.d: उत्तरोत्तरं युद्धेषु विष्णुना पराजितेन प्रह्लादेन पुत्राय राज्यप्रदानम् . देवासुराणां वर्षसहस्रिकमाटिवकाख्यं युद्धम् . तस्मिन् युद्धे शक्रकृतो विरोचनवधः . विरोचने हते ब्रह्मणा दैत्यराज्ये बलेरभिषेचनम् . देवान् विजित्य बलिना त्रैलोक्यराज्यकरणम् . विष्णोर्वामनावतारः, वामनस्य बलिसद्मगमनम् . बलिवामनसंवादः, बलेः सकाशे वामनस्य पदत्रयोन्मितभूमियाचनम् . बलौ वामनाय भूमिं दातुं प्रवृत्ते प्रह्लादेन निषेधनम् . वलि- प्रह्लादसंवादः, प्रसंगाद् बलिकृतन(म?)ष्टकेतिवृत्ताख्यानम् . बलिना वामनाय संकल्प्य पदत्रयप्रदानम् . बलेरुपरि ससाधुवादं देवैः कृता पुष्पवृष्टिः .
7.20.m: Prahlāda, repeatedly defeated in battles by Viṣṇu, hands over the kingdom to his son. The thousand-year battle between the gods and asuras called Āṭivaka. In that battle, the slaying of Virocana by Śakra. When Virocana was slain, Bali's consecration to the kingship of the daityas by Brahmā. Conquering the gods, Bali rules over the three worlds. The Vāmana incarnation of Viṣṇu; Vāmana's arrival at Bali's dwelling. The conversation between Bali and Vāmana; Vāmana's begging from Bali for land measuring three strides. When Bali sets out to give the land to Vāmana, Prahlāda forbids him. The dialogue between Bali and Prahlāda; incidentally, the narration of the account of Bali's eightfold homage(?). Bali, having made the resolve, grants the three strides to Vāmana. A shower of flowers cast over Bali by the gods accompanied by cries of 'Well done!'
117. In the one hundred and seventeenth chapter:

7.20.s: pratigrahānantaraṃ vāmanasya padatrayārthaṃ vikramaṇam . tad dṛṣṭvā daityānāṃ trivikramasyopari śastrāstrairākramaṇam . devadānavayuddham, daityānāṃ parājayaḥ, brahmaṇā baleḥ samayakaraṇam . devānāṃ rājyaprāptiḥ, baleḥ pātālapraveśaḥ, devaiḥ kṛto vāmanastutiḥ . devānāṃ stutyā saṃjātatoṣātiśayasya vāmanarūpasya viṣṇoḥ svābhimānato yogabhraṃśaḥ . yogabhraṣṭe tasmin tadantareṇāsurīpāpmāyāḥ praveśaḥ . tatkṛtā ca viṣṇościrantanī vāmanarūpatāpattiḥ .
7.20.d: प्रतिग्रहानन्तरं वामनस्य पदत्रयार्थं विक्रमणम् . तद् दृष्ट्वा दैत्यानां त्रिविक्रमस्योपरि शस्त्रास्त्रैराक्रमणम् . देवदानवयुद्धम्, दैत्यानां पराजयः, ब्रह्मणा बलेः समयकरणम् . देवानां राज्यप्राप्तिः, बलेः पातालप्रवेशः, देवैः कृतो वामनस्तुतिः . देवानां स्तुत्या संजाततोषातिशयस्य वामनरूपस्य विष्णोः स्वाभिमानतो योगभ्रंशः . योगभ्रष्टे तस्मिन् तदन्तरेणासुरीपाप्मायाः प्रवेशः . तत्कृता च विष्णोश्चिरन्तनी वामनरूपतापत्तिः .
7.20.m: After receiving the gift, Vāmana's striding forth to measure the three paces. Seeing this, the attack of the daityas against Trivikrama with weapons and missiles. The war between the gods and dānavas; the defeat of the daityas; Brahmā's agreement with Bali. The gods regain their sovereignty; Bali's entry into Pātāla; the praise of Vāmana uttered by the gods. Because of the excessive delight born of the praise of the gods, Viṣṇu in the form of Vāmana falls from yoga due to his self-conceit. As he fell from yoga, the demonic sin entered him through that [gap]. And through that, Viṣṇu came to retain the form of Vāmana permanently.
118. In the one hundred and eighteenth chapter:

7.20.s: pratigrahakṛtayā pāpmayāviṣṭasya viṣṇostatpāpmāprahāṇārthaṃ brahmaṇo vākyāt saptarṣiprabhṛtimunijanasahitānāṃ devānāṃ vāmanamādāya tīrthayātrāyai prasthānam . śukopākhyānam - suṣumṇāpuṣkariṇīprabhṛtikatipayapuṇyatīrthayātrā- nannaramagrato gacchatāṃ teṣāmekatra śuṣkatarukoṭare kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ śuṣyataḥ śukasya tairdarśanam . śukaśakrasaṃvādaḥ., śukakṛtaṃ tarumahimavarṇanam . śukāya śakreṇa varadānam, śakrasya varadānatastasya śuṣkataroḥ punarujjīvanam, śukasya ca brahmaloka- prāptiḥ .
7.20.d: प्रतिग्रहकृतया पाप्मयाविष्टस्य विष्णोस्तत्पाप्माप्रहाणार्थं ब्रह्मणो वाक्यात् सप्तर्षिप्रभृतिमुनिजनसहितानां देवानां वामनमादाय तीर्थयात्रायै प्रस्थानम् . शुकोपाख्यानम् - सुषुम्णापुष्करिणीप्रभृतिकतिपयपुण्यतीर्थयात्रा- नन्नरमग्रतो गच्छतां तेषामेकत्र शुष्कतरुकोटरे क्षुत्तृड्भ्यां शुष्यतः शुकस्य तैर्दर्शनम् . शुकशक्रसंवादः., शुककृतं तरुमहिमवर्णनम् . शुकाय शक्रेण वरदानम्, शक्रस्य वरदानतस्तस्य शुष्कतरोः पुनरुज्जीवनम्, शुकस्य च ब्रह्मलोक- प्राप्तिः .
7.20.m: For the dispelling of the sin that possessed Viṣṇu on account of accepting a gift, the gods, accompanied by the Seven Seers and other sages, set out on a pilgrimage to sacred fords taking Vāmana with them, by the word of Brahmā. The episode of the parrot: As they journey on after visiting several holy sacred fords beginning with Suṣumṇā-puṣkariṇī, they see in one place a parrot withered by hunger and thirst inside the hollow of a withered tree. The conversation between the parrot and Śakra; description of the greatness of the tree by the parrot. The granting of a boon to the parrot by Śakra; from Śakra's granting of the boon, that withered tree is restored to life, and the parrot attains the world of Brahmā.
119. In the one hundred and nineteenth chapter:

7.20.s:
( 1) gautamyupākhyānam, - kṛmilāpuryāmekasyā gautamīnāmnyā vidhavāyā brāhmaṇyāstapasi saktāyāstadbālaputrasya kṛṣṇasarpadaṃśanād maraṇam . arjunanāmnaḥ vyādhena gautamyāstadvṛttāntakathanam . gautamyā vilāpaḥ . vyādhena sarpasya nigrahaṇam, sarpavyādhasaṃvādaḥ, gautamyāstapaso bhītānāṃ kālamṛtyuniyatikṛtāntayamanāṃ bālamṛtyu ( nimitta) kāraṇatvena sarpādyuttarottarakṛtābhiyogānāṃ sarveṣāmekaikaśastatrāgamanam . yamagautamīsaṃvādaḥ, yamamukhād dehināṃ janmamaraṇayoḥ svakṛtaśubhāśubhakarmanimittatvaśravaṇād gautamyā manaso duḥkhaśamanam . devānāṃ varadānena mṛtabālasya punarujjīvanam .
(2) yātudhānyupākhyānam - kṛmilāto gacchatāṃ devanāṃ kṛtyānāmatīrthasthalaprāptiḥ, kṛtyāsamākhyānaprasaṃgāgataṃ tṛṇabindūpākhyānam . yājanaprārthanānaṅgīkārāt prakupitena tṛṇabindunā saptarṣīn prati kṛtyāpreṣaṇam . saptarṣīṇāṃ vināśāya śubhāṃ vāpīmupāśrityāntaraṃ pratīkṣamāṇāyā yātudhānyaparanāmnyā kṛtyāyāḥ parivrāḍveṣeṇendreṇa hananam . tīrthayātropasaṃhāraḥ, viṣṇoraśvamedhena yajanam . tatra śaṃkarasyāgamanam .
7.20.d:
( 1) गौतम्युपाख्यानम्, - कृमिलापुर्यामेकस्या गौतमीनाम्न्या विधवाया ब्राह्मण्यास्तपसि सक्तायास्तद्बालपुत्रस्य कृष्णसर्पदंशनाद् मरणम् . अर्जुननाम्नः व्याधेन गौतम्यास्तद्वृत्तान्तकथनम् . गौतम्या विलापः . व्याधेन सर्पस्य निग्रहणम्, सर्पव्याधसंवादः, गौतम्यास्तपसो भीतानां कालमृत्युनियतिकृतान्तयमनां बालमृत्यु ( निमित्त) कारणत्वेन सर्पाद्युत्तरोत्तरकृताभियोगानां सर्वेषामेकैकशस्तत्रागमनम् . यमगौतमीसंवादः, यममुखाद् देहिनां जन्ममरणयोः स्वकृतशुभाशुभकर्मनिमित्तत्वश्रवणाद् गौतम्या मनसो दुःखशमनम् . देवानां वरदानेन मृतबालस्य पुनरुज्जीवनम् .
(2) यातुधान्युपाख्यानम् - कृमिलातो गच्छतां देवनां कृत्यानामतीर्थस्थलप्राप्तिः, कृत्यासमाख्यानप्रसंगागतं तृणबिन्दूपाख्यानम् . याजनप्रार्थनानङ्गीकारात् प्रकुपितेन तृणबिन्दुना सप्तर्षीन् प्रति कृत्याप्रेषणम् . सप्तर्षीणां विनाशाय शुभां वापीमुपाश्रित्यान्तरं प्रतीक्षमाणाया यातुधान्यपरनाम्न्या कृत्यायाः परिव्राड्वेषेणेन्द्रेण हननम् . तीर्थयात्रोपसंहारः, विष्णोरश्वमेधेन यजनम् . तत्र शंकरस्यागमनम् .
7.20.m:
(1) The subsidiary narrative of Gautamī: In the city of Kṛmilā, the death of the young son of a widowed brahmin woman named Gautamī, who was devoted to austerity, from the bite of a black serpent. The relating of that incident to Gautamī by a hunter named Arjuna. The lamentation of Gautamī. The capture of the serpent by the hunter; the dialogue between the serpent and the hunter; the arrival there, one by one, of Kāla, Mṛtyu, Niyati, Kṛtānta, and Yama, who, terrified of Gautamī's austerity, had successive accusations hurled against them beginning with the serpent as being the cause [and] instrument of the child's death. The dialogue between Yama and Gautamī; the pacification of Gautamī's mental grief upon hearing from Yama's mouth that living beings' birth and death are caused by their own actions, whether auspicious or inauspicious. The restoration of the dead child to life through the boon granted by the gods.
(2) The subsidiary narrative of Yātudhānī: The arrival of the gods, departing from Kṛmilā, at the sacred ford and place called Kṛtyā; the subsidiary narrative of Tṛṇabindu introduced in connection with the account of Kṛtyā. The dispatching of Kṛtyā against the seven seers by Tṛṇabindu, who was infuriated because of their refusal to grant his request to officiate as priests. The slaying, by Indra in the guise of a wandering mendicant, of Kṛtyā, whose other name was Yātudhānī, who was residing by an auspicious reservoir awaiting an opportune moment for the destruction of the seven seers. The conclusion of the pilgrimage to sacred fords; Viṣṇu's sacrifice by means of a horse sacrifice. The arrival of Śaṃkara there.
In chapter 120:

7.20.s: bhagavataḥ śūlinaḥ pārvatyā saha rajanyāṃ śmaśānadarśanāyābhigamanam . kramādujjayinīṃ prāptena bhagavatā śūlinā śmaśāne saṃskārārthamānītaṃ mṛtaṃ viprabālamujjīvya tasya gaṇatvapradānam . tato gatvā, tīrthayātrāṃ samāpya hima- vacchikhare yajñavareṇa yajatāṃ devānāṃ mahādevena darśanadānaṃ vareṇacchandanaṃ ca .
7.20.d: भगवतः शूलिनः पार्वत्या सह रजन्यां श्मशानदर्शनायाभिगमनम् . क्रमादुज्जयिनीं प्राप्तेन भगवता शूलिना श्मशाने संस्कारार्थमानीतं मृतं विप्रबालमुज्जीव्य तस्य गणत्वप्रदानम् . ततो गत्वा, तीर्थयात्रां समाप्य हिम- वच्छिखरे यज्ञवरेण यजतां देवानां महादेवेन दर्शनदानं वरेणच्छन्दनं च .
7.20.m: The Lord, the Trident-holder, going together with Pārvatī at night to view a cremation ground. The Lord, the Trident-holder, having gradually reached Ujjayinī, restoring to life the dead son of a brahmin brought to the cremation ground for funeral rites, and granting him the status of an attendant gaṇa. Then going and granting a vision, as Mahādeva, to the gods performing the best of sacrifices on the peak of the Himālaya after completing their pilgrimage to sacred fords, and pleasing them with a boon.
In chapter 121:

7.20.s: viṣṇoḥ pāpmāprahāṇārthaṃ śaṃbhusavidhe devānāṃ prārthanā . mahādevena tatra girau śūlāropaṇena jaladhārāniḥsāraṇam . tajjale snapitasya viṣṇoḥ śarīrānmūrttāyāḥ pāpmāyā abhiniḥsaraṇam . viṣṇunā pāśupatavratavaraṇam, tuṣṭena hareṇa viṣṇave svaśarīrārdhapradānam . tannimittaṃ ca tasya viṣṇuśaṃkaratvam (harihararūpatvam) . trailokyarājyārthe punardevāsura- yuddham . mahādevasyājñayā paraśurāmeṇaikākinā yudhi sarveṣāṃ saiṃhikeyagaṇānāṃ hananam . dānavānāṃ palāyanam,- devairjāmadagnyāya varapradānam .
7.20.d: विष्णोः पाप्माप्रहाणार्थं शंभुसविधे देवानां प्रार्थना . महादेवेन तत्र गिरौ शूलारोपणेन जलधारानिःसारणम् . तज्जले स्नपितस्य विष्णोः शरीरान्मूर्त्तायाः पाप्माया अभिनिःसरणम् . विष्णुना पाशुपतव्रतवरणम्, तुष्टेन हरेण विष्णवे स्वशरीरार्धप्रदानम् . तन्निमित्तं च तस्य विष्णुशंकरत्वम् (हरिहररूपत्वम्) . त्रैलोक्यराज्यार्थे पुनर्देवासुर- युद्धम् . महादेवस्याज्ञया परशुरामेणैकाकिना युधि सर्वेषां सैंहिकेयगणानां हननम् . दानवानां पलायनम्,- देवैर्जामदग्न्याय वरप्रदानम् .
7.20.m: The plea of the gods in the presence of Śambhu for the removal of Viṣṇu's sin. The issuing forth of a stream of water by Mahādeva's implanting his trident there on the mountain. The emergence of sin in embodied form from the body of Viṣṇu, who was bathed in that water. Viṣṇu's taking up of the Pāśupata vow; the granting by Hara, who was pleased, of half of his own body to Viṣṇu; and through that cause, his state as Viṣṇu-Śaṃkara (having the form of Harihara). Another battle between the gods and the asuras for the sovereignty of the three worlds. The slaying of all the hosts of the sons of Siṃhikā in battle by Paraśurāma alone by command of Mahādeva. The flight of the dānavas; the granting of a boon to the descendant of Jamadagni by the gods.
In chapter 122:

7.20.s: kālanemiparākramaḥ, keśavakālanemiyuddham . viṣṇukṛtaḥ kālanemivadhaḥ, tārakamayayuddhopasaṃhāraḥ . puriścandra- kṣetrasamākhyānam, nārāvaṇapāpmāprahāṇāya devatābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tryambakastotram . viṣṇoḥ kṛte devatābhiḥ puraścaraṇā- nuṣṭhānam . mahādevājñayā sarvaiḥ pāśupatavratācaraṇam . viṣṇostapaścaryā, viṣṇoḥ pāpmāprahāṇam . hariścandra- kṣetrasamākhyānam .
7.20.d: कालनेमिपराक्रमः, केशवकालनेमियुद्धम् . विष्णुकृतः कालनेमिवधः, तारकमययुद्धोपसंहारः . पुरिश्चन्द्र- क्षेत्रसमाख्यानम्, नारावणपाप्माप्रहाणाय देवताभिः कृतं त्र्यम्बकस्तोत्रम् . विष्णोः कृते देवताभिः पुरश्चरणा- नुष्ठानम् . महादेवाज्ञया सर्वैः पाशुपतव्रताचरणम् . विष्णोस्तपश्चर्या, विष्णोः पाप्माप्रहाणम् . हरिश्चन्द्र- क्षेत्रसमाख्यानम् .
7.20.m: The prowess of Kālanemi; the combat between Keśava and Kālanemi. The slaying of Kālanemi performed by Viṣṇu; the conclusion of the Tārakāmaya war. The account of the Puriścandra sacred field; the hymn of praise to Tryambaka performed by the deities for the removal of Nārāyaṇa's sin. The performance of preparatory rites by the deities on behalf of Viṣṇu. The practice of the Pāśupata vow by all in accordance with Mahādeva's command. The practice of austerity by Viṣṇu; the removal of Viṣṇu's sin. The account of the Hariścandra sacred field.
In chapter 123:

7.20.s: jāmadagnyena puriścandre mahādevadarśanam . mahādevena jāmadagnyāya cirajīvitvādivarasaptakapradānapūrvakaṃ sarahasya - dhanurveda( vidyājñāna) pradānam . jāmadagnyena piturvairaniryātanārthaṃ pṛthivyā niḥ kṣatratvakaraṇam . jāmadagnyakṛtaḥ śriyāḥ paribhavaḥ . jāmadagnyena yajñānuṣṭhānam, kaśyapāya pṛthvīpradānam . jāmadagnyasya kāśyapabhūmiṃ parityajya samudrāntardvīpe nivasanam .
7.20.d: जामदग्न्येन पुरिश्चन्द्रे महादेवदर्शनम् . महादेवेन जामदग्न्याय चिरजीवित्वादिवरसप्तकप्रदानपूर्वकं सरहस्य - धनुर्वेद( विद्याज्ञान) प्रदानम् . जामदग्न्येन पितुर्वैरनिर्यातनार्थं पृथिव्या निः क्षत्रत्वकरणम् . जामदग्न्यकृतः श्रियाः परिभवः . जामदग्न्येन यज्ञानुष्ठानम्, कश्यपाय पृथ्वीप्रदानम् . जामदग्न्यस्य काश्यपभूमिं परित्यज्य समुद्रान्तर्द्वीपे निवसनम् .
7.20.m: The vision of Mahādeva obtained by the descendant of Jamadagni at Puriścandra. The bestowal of the archery lore along with its secret knowledge upon the descendant of Jamadagni by Mahādeva, preceded by the granting of seven boons beginning with long life. The clearing of the earth of kṣatriyas by the descendant of Jamadagni in order to avenge his father's hostility. The humiliation of Śrī performed by the descendant of Jamadagni. The performance of a sacrifice by the descendant of Jamadagni; the gifting of the earth to Kaśyapa. The departure from Kaśyapa's land and dwelling of the descendant of Jamadagni on an island within the ocean.
In chapter 124:

7.20.s: kaśyapapālitāyāḥ pṛthivyā adhogamanam . kaśyapasya svatapobalāt svayaṃ pṛthvībhāvenāvasthānam, pṛthivyā kaśyapasya prasādanam, pṛthivyāḥ kaśyapaduhitṛtvam .
7.20.d: कश्यपपालितायाः पृथिव्या अधोगमनम् . कश्यपस्य स्वतपोबलात् स्वयं पृथ्वीभावेनावस्थानम्, पृथिव्या कश्यपस्य प्रसादनम्, पृथिव्याः कश्यपदुहितृत्वम् .
7.20.m: The sinking down of the earth protected by Kaśyapa. Kaśyapa's standing in the state of the earth himself by the power of his own austerity; the earth's propitiation of Kaśyapa; the earth's becoming the daughter of Kaśyapa.
In chapter 125:

7.20.s: vipracitterbhastrāpade tapaścaryā, tasya mahādevādvaraprāptiḥ, devāsurasaṃgrāmaḥ, lomaharṣaṇaṃ dhvajayuddham . indrakṛto dānava- saṃhāraḥ .
7.20.d: विप्रचित्तेर्भस्त्रापदे तपश्चर्या, तस्य महादेवाद्वरप्राप्तिः, देवासुरसंग्रामः, लोमहर्षणं ध्वजयुद्धम् . इन्द्रकृतो दानव- संहारः .
7.20.m: Vipracitti's practice of austerity at Bhastrāpada; his obtaining of a boon from Mahādeva; the battle between gods and asuras; the hair-raising clash of banners. The slaughter of the dānavas performed by Indra.
In chapter 126:

7.20.s: vyāsajijñāsayā bhastrāpadakṣetrasamākhyānāya gaṅgāvataraṇamupākhyātuṃ sagaropākhyānam sagaranāmasamākhyā, sagarasyā- śvamedhena yajanam, aśvāpaharaṇam, aśvānveṣaṇāya sāgarotkhananam, kapilāvamānanāt sagarasutānāṃ saṃhāraḥ, sagarā- jñayāṃśumataḥ kapilāśramagamanam .
7.20.d: व्यासजिज्ञासया भस्त्रापदक्षेत्रसमाख्यानाय गङ्गावतरणमुपाख्यातुं सगरोपाख्यानम् सगरनामसमाख्या, सगरस्या- श्वमेधेन यजनम्, अश्वापहरणम्, अश्वान्वेषणाय सागरोत्खननम्, कपिलावमाननात् सगरसुतानां संहारः, सगरा- ज्ञयांशुमतः कपिलाश्रमगमनम् .
7.20.m: Through the inquiry of Vyāsa, for the purpose of narrating the descent of the Gaṅgā in order to explain the Bhastrāpada sacred field, the subsidiary narrative of Sagara; the etymological account of the name Sagara; Sagara's sacrificing with a horse sacrifice; the theft of the horse; the digging up of the ocean to search for the horse; the slaughter of the sons of Sagara due to their disrespect toward Kapila; the departure of Aṃśumat to Kapila's hermitage at the command of Sagara.
In chapter 127:

7.20.s: aṃśumatkapilasaṃvādaḥ, aṃśumato vainateyena samāgamaḥ, sagarāṇāmuddhārāya vainateyakṛto gaṅgānayanopadeśaḥ, kapilāśramā- daśvapratyānayanam, sagarasya yajñasamāptiḥ, gaṅgānayanāya sathāvasaraṃ tapaścaratoraṃśumaddilīpayormanorathasiddhiṃ vinaiva svargamanama, gaṅgāvatāraṇopakramaḥ, bhagīrathasya tapaścaryā . brahmaṇo varaprāptiḥ, bhagīrathena śaṃkaratoṣaṇam, gaṅgāyā garvaḥ, śaṃkarasya kopaḥ, śaṃkaraprasādanārthaṃ devaiḥ kṛtā rudrāṇīstutiḥ, tatra tasyā lokajanītvopapādanāya devairbhastrāśabdaprayogaḥ pārvatyā śivaprasādanam, śivena gaṅgāvegadhāraṇāṅgīkaraṇam . bhastrāpadakṣetraniruktiḥ bhastrāpadabhasmeśvarayormahima- varṇanam .
7.20.d: अंशुमत्कपिलसंवादः, अंशुमतो वैनतेयेन समागमः, सगराणामुद्धाराय वैनतेयकृतो गङ्गानयनोपदेशः, कपिलाश्रमा- दश्वप्रत्यानयनम्, सगरस्य यज्ञसमाप्तिः, गङ्गानयनाय सथावसरं तपश्चरतोरंशुमद्दिलीपयोर्मनोरथसिद्धिं विनैव स्वर्गमनम, गङ्गावतारणोपक्रमः, भगीरथस्य तपश्चर्या . ब्रह्मणो वरप्राप्तिः, भगीरथेन शंकरतोषणम्, गङ्गाया गर्वः, शंकरस्य कोपः, शंकरप्रसादनार्थं देवैः कृता रुद्राणीस्तुतिः, तत्र तस्या लोकजनीत्वोपपादनाय देवैर्भस्त्राशब्दप्रयोगः पार्वत्या शिवप्रसादनम्, शिवेन गङ्गावेगधारणाङ्गीकरणम् . भस्त्रापदक्षेत्रनिरुक्तिः भस्त्रापदभस्मेश्वरयोर्महिम- वर्णनम् .
7.20.m: The dialogue between Aṃśumat and Kapila; the meeting of Aṃśumat with the son of Vinatā; the counsel given by the son of Vinatā regarding the bringing of the Gaṅgā for the deliverance of the Sagara princes; the bringing back of the horse from Kapila's hermitage; the completion of Sagara's sacrifice; the ascent to heaven, without the fulfillment of their desired aim, of Aṃśumat and Dilīpa who practiced austerity in turn to bring down the Gaṅgā; the commencement of the descent of the Gaṅgā; the practice of austerity by Bhagīratha. The obtaining of a boon from Brahmā; the propitiation of Śaṃkara by Bhagīratha; the pride of the Gaṅgā; the anger of Śaṃkara; the hymn to Rudrāṇī performed by the gods to propitiate Śaṃkara; the employment of the word 'bhastrā' by the gods in that hymn to establish her nature as the mother of the worlds; the propitiation of Śiva by Pārvatī; Śiva's agreement to bear the torrent of the Gaṅgā. The etymology of the Bhastrāpada sacred field; the description of the greatness of Bhastrāpada and Bhasmeśvara.
In chapter 128:

7.20.s: bhastrāpade devatābhiḥ śivaliṅgāni saṃsthāpya svasvanāmmā tīrthānāṃ sthāpanam . vajropala (bhastrāpada?) nāmni himavacchikhare gaṅgāvataraṇaprekṣaṇāya mahataḥ samājasyopasthitiḥ, umāsahāyasya devadevasya tatrāgamanam . mahādeva- vacanād bhagīrathena gaṅgāyāḥ saṃsmaraṇam, gaṅgāyāḥ svarlokādavataraṇam, divovatarantyā gaṅgāyā madhyepatha- mākāśagaṅgādināmaniṣpattiḥ, tasyā eva punastrisrotādi nāmāntaraniṣpattiḥ . tribhirvegairmahatā javena patantyā gaṅgāyāḥ śivena svajaṭābhāre grahaṇam . jaṭājūṭevaruddhāyāstasyāstatraiva cirakālamavasthānam . devānāṃ prārthanayā śivena svajaṭābhārād gaṅgāyā avamocanam . bindusarasa utpattiḥ, gaṅgāyāstribhiḥ srotobhistato niḥsaraṇam . tasyā madhyasrotaso bhāgīrathīti samākhyā . gaṅgādvārotpattiḥ, gaṅgāvataraṇasthalasya bhastrāpadamityākhyā .
7.20.d: भस्त्रापदे देवताभिः शिवलिङ्गानि संस्थाप्य स्वस्वनाम्मा तीर्थानां स्थापनम् . वज्रोपल (भस्त्रापद?) नाम्नि हिमवच्छिखरे गङ्गावतरणप्रेक्षणाय महतः समाजस्योपस्थितिः, उमासहायस्य देवदेवस्य तत्रागमनम् . महादेव- वचनाद् भगीरथेन गङ्गायाः संस्मरणम्, गङ्गायाः स्वर्लोकादवतरणम्, दिवोवतरन्त्या गङ्गाया मध्येपथ- माकाशगङ्गादिनामनिष्पत्तिः, तस्या एव पुनस्त्रिस्रोतादि नामान्तरनिष्पत्तिः . त्रिभिर्वेगैर्महता जवेन पतन्त्या गङ्गायाः शिवेन स्वजटाभारे ग्रहणम् . जटाजूटेवरुद्धायास्तस्यास्तत्रैव चिरकालमवस्थानम् . देवानां प्रार्थनया शिवेन स्वजटाभाराद् गङ्गाया अवमोचनम् . बिन्दुसरस उत्पत्तिः, गङ्गायास्त्रिभिः स्रोतोभिस्ततो निःसरणम् . तस्या मध्यस्रोतसो भागीरथीति समाख्या . गङ्गाद्वारोत्पत्तिः, गङ्गावतरणस्थलस्य भस्त्रापदमित्याख्या .
7.20.m: The installation of Śivaliṅgas by the deities at Bhastrāpada and the establishment of sacred fords under their respective names. The gathering of a vast assembly on the peak of the Himalayas named Vajropala (or Bhastrāpada?) to witness the descent of the Gaṅgā; the arrival there of the God of Gods accompanied by Umā. Bhagīratha's invocation of the Gaṅgā upon the word of Mahādeva; the Gaṅgā's descent from the heavenly world; during her descent from heaven along the path, the origin of names such as Ākāśagaṅgā; furthermore, the origin of other names of hers such as Trisrotas. Śiva's catching in his mass of matted hair the Gaṅgā falling with immense force in three streams. Her remaining confined within the knot of matted locks for a long time. Śiva's releasing the Gaṅgā from his mass of matted hair at the prayer of the gods. The origin of Bindusaras; the issuing forth of the Gaṅgā from there in three streams. The designation of its middle stream as the Bhāgīrathī. The origin of Gaṅgādvāra; the naming of the place of the Gaṅgā's descent as Bhastrāpada.
In the one hundred and twenty-ninth chapter:

7.20.s: hālāhalayuddhākhyānam, balasya netṛtve hālāhalākhyasya dānavagaṇasya devaiḥ saha saṃgrāmaḥ, prathamatosurāṇāṃ vijayaḥ, paścānmahādevānugrahāddevānāṃ vijayaḥ, indreṇa balasya hananam . asurāṇāṃ parājayaḥ, andhakārayuddham . devāntakasya tapaścaryā, rudraprasādāttāmasīṃ māyāmāśritya devāntakena devānāṃ prabādhanam . ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanād devairasurāṇāṃ mohāyāpsarasāṃ preṣaṇam, apsarorūpamohitānāṃ dānavānāṃ parasparayuddhena svataḥ saṃhāraḥ, avaśiṣṭānāṃ devaiḥ saṃharaṇam .
7.20.d: हालाहलयुद्धाख्यानम्, बलस्य नेतृत्वे हालाहलाख्यस्य दानवगणस्य देवैः सह संग्रामः, प्रथमतोसुराणां विजयः, पश्चान्महादेवानुग्रहाद्देवानां विजयः, इन्द्रेण बलस्य हननम् . असुराणां पराजयः, अन्धकारयुद्धम् . देवान्तकस्य तपश्चर्या, रुद्रप्रसादात्तामसीं मायामाश्रित्य देवान्तकेन देवानां प्रबाधनम् . ऋषीणां वचनाद् देवैरसुराणां मोहायाप्सरसां प्रेषणम्, अप्सरोरूपमोहितानां दानवानां परस्परयुद्धेन स्वतः संहारः, अवशिष्टानां देवैः संहरणम् .
7.20.m: The account of the battle with the Hālāhala [demons]; the battle of the host of Dānavas named Hālāhala, under the leadership of Bala, with the gods; at first, the victory of the asuras; afterwards, through the grace of Mahādeva, the victory of the gods; the slaying of Bala by Indra. The defeat of the asuras; the battle in darkness. Devāntaka's practice of austerities; Devāntaka's afflicting the gods by resorting to darkness-born illusory power through the grace of Rudra. At the word of the seers, the sending of apsarases by the gods to bewilder the asuras; the destruction of the Dānavas by their own hand in mutual combat, infatuated by the beauty of the apsarases; the slaughter of the remainder by the gods.
In the one hundred and thirtieth chapter:

7.20.s: andhakākhyānam (pūrvaprakṛtam), andhakena mandaraprasthe pārvatyā darśanam . pārvatīrūpadarśanāt kṣubhitasya kāmopahata- cetasondhakasya tāṃ prati duṣṭabhāvanā . prahlādasyopadeśaḥ, andhakasya durāgrahaḥ . andhakasya duṣṭabhāvaṃ buddhvā kopā- cchūlamudyamya taṃ hantuṃ pravṛttāyāḥ pārvatyā mahādevena niṣedhanam, pārvatyāstatonyato gamanam, andhakena saha yoddhuṃ mahādevājñayā nandinā sakalagaṇānāmāhvānam, sagaṇānāṃ sakalagaṇanāyakānāṃ mahāsamājasya tatropasthitiḥ, upasthitānāṃ gaṇānāṃ nandinā mahādevāya rūpaguṇasaṃkhyādivijñāpanam .
7.20.d: अन्धकाख्यानम् (पूर्वप्रकृतम्), अन्धकेन मन्दरप्रस्थे पार्वत्या दर्शनम् . पार्वतीरूपदर्शनात् क्षुभितस्य कामोपहत- चेतसोन्धकस्य तां प्रति दुष्टभावना . प्रह्लादस्योपदेशः, अन्धकस्य दुराग्रहः . अन्धकस्य दुष्टभावं बुद्ध्वा कोपा- च्छूलमुद्यम्य तं हन्तुं प्रवृत्तायाः पार्वत्या महादेवेन निषेधनम्, पार्वत्यास्ततोन्यतो गमनम्, अन्धकेन सह योद्धुं महादेवाज्ञया नन्दिना सकलगणानामाह्वानम्, सगणानां सकलगणनायकानां महासमाजस्य तत्रोपस्थितिः, उपस्थितानां गणानां नन्दिना महादेवाय रूपगुणसंख्यादिविज्ञापनम् .
7.20.m: The story of Andhaka (commenced previously); Andhaka's seeing Pārvatī on the plateau of Mount Mandara. The wicked intention toward her of Andhaka, agitated and smitten with desire upon seeing the beauty of Pārvatī. Prahlāda's counsel; Andhaka's stubborn persistence. Perceiving Andhaka's evil intention, Pārvatī, setting out in anger to kill him after raising her trident, is restrained by Mahādeva; Pārvatī's departure elsewhere from that place; at Mahādeva's command, Nandin's summons of all the gaṇas to fight with Andhaka; the presence there of a vast gathering of all the gaṇa-leaders together with their hosts; Nandin's report to Mahādeva regarding the appearance, qualities, numbers, and other details of the gathered gaṇas.
In the one hundred and thirty-first chapter:

7.20.s: mahādevena gaṇānāṃ mahāsamājasya nirīkṣaṇam, saṃkhyānaśravaṇam, mahādevājñayā nandinaḥ saṃrakṣakatāyāṃ bṛhaspatinā- gnāvāhutipradānam . mandaramārurukṣūṇāmasurabalānāṃ pramathaiḥ saha saṃgharṣaḥ, andhakabalānāṃ mandarārohaṇam . mandarasthi- tivarṇanam .
7.20.d: महादेवेन गणानां महासमाजस्य निरीक्षणम्, संख्यानश्रवणम्, महादेवाज्ञया नन्दिनः संरक्षकतायां बृहस्पतिना- ग्नावाहुतिप्रदानम् . मन्दरमारुरुक्षूणामसुरबलानां प्रमथैः सह संघर्षः, अन्धकबलानां मन्दरारोहणम् . मन्दरस्थि- तिवर्णनम् .
7.20.m: Mahādeva's inspection of the vast assembly of gaṇas; his listening to the enumeration; under the guardianship of Nandin by Mahādeva's command, Bṛhaspati's offering of oblations into the fire. The clash of the asura forces desirous of ascending Mandara with the pramathas; the ascent of the forces of Andhaka onto Mount Mandara. Description of the situation on Mandara.
In the one hundred and thirty-second chapter:

7.20.s: śukreṇāndhakāya pramathānīkanāyakānāṃ paricayapradānam, andhakasya prārthanayā śukreṇāsurabale parvatavyūharacanam . mahādevājñayā bṛhaspatinā pramathānīke vajravyūharacanam .
7.20.d: शुक्रेणान्धकाय प्रमथानीकनायकानां परिचयप्रदानम्, अन्धकस्य प्रार्थनया शुक्रेणासुरबले पर्वतव्यूहरचनम् . महादेवाज्ञया बृहस्पतिना प्रमथानीके वज्रव्यूहरचनम् .
7.20.m: Śukra's introduction of the leaders of the pramatha army to Andhaka; at Andhaka's request, Śukra's formation of the mountain-array among the asura forces. At Mahādeva's command, Bṛhaspati's formation of the thunderbolt-array among the pramatha forces.
In the one hundred and thirty-third chapter:

7.20.s: pramathāsurasaṃgrāmadarśanārthaṃ vimānakoṭibhirupasthitānāṃ devānāṃ samājairnabhomaṇḍalasamācchādanam . pramathāsurasainyayo- ryuddhopakramaḥ, (gaṇayuddhārambhaḥ) .
7.20.d: प्रमथासुरसंग्रामदर्शनार्थं विमानकोटिभिरुपस्थितानां देवानां समाजैर्नभोमण्डलसमाच्छादनम् . प्रमथासुरसैन्ययो- र्युद्धोपक्रमः, (गणयुद्धारम्भः) .
7.20.m: The vault of heaven being covered by the assemblies of gods who arrived in tens of millions of aerial chariots to watch the battle between the pramathas and asuras. The commencement of the battle between the pramatha and asura armies; (the beginning of the battle of the gaṇas).
In the one hundred and thirty-fourth chapter:
The chaotic battle between the armies of the pramathas and asuras; the flowing of rivers carrying torrents of blood on the battlefield.
In the one hundred and thirty-fifth chapter:

7.20.s: pramathāsurasusainyayostumule yuddhe vartamāne śaṃkukarṇaprabhṛtīnāṃ daśānāṃ pravaragaṇeśvarāṇāmasurabalāntaḥpraveśaḥ, asurāṇāṃ vyūhabhaṅgaḥ, ubhayoḥ pakṣayordāruṇaḥ saṃgharṣaḥ .
7.20.d: प्रमथासुरसुसैन्ययोस्तुमुले युद्धे वर्तमाने शंकुकर्णप्रभृतीनां दशानां प्रवरगणेश्वराणामसुरबलान्तःप्रवेशः, असुराणां व्यूहभङ्गः, उभयोः पक्षयोर्दारुणः संघर्षः .
7.20.m: While the tumultuous battle between the two forces of the pramathas and asuras is underway, the penetration into the asura army by the ten foremost leaders of the gaṇas headed by Śaṅkukarṇa; the breaking of the asuras' battle-array; the terrible clash between the two sides.
In the one hundred and thirty-sixth chapter:

7.20.s: virocanasya pramathānīke praveśaḥ, virocanasya parākramaḥ, vināyakavirocanayuddham . vināyakaparākramaḥ, bāṇakuṇḍodara- yuddham, bāṇavināyakayuddham, vināyakarāhuyuddham . gaṇeśvaradānaveśvarāṇāṃ saṃsaktayuddham .
7.20.d: विरोचनस्य प्रमथानीके प्रवेशः, विरोचनस्य पराक्रमः, विनायकविरोचनयुद्धम् . विनायकपराक्रमः, बाणकुण्डोदर- युद्धम्, बाणविनायकयुद्धम्, विनायकराहुयुद्धम् . गणेश्वरदानवेश्वराणां संसक्तयुद्धम् .
7.20.m: Virocana's entry into the ranks of the pramathas; Virocana's valor; the duel between Vināyaka and Virocana. Vināyaka's valor; the battle between Bāṇa and Kuṇḍodara; the battle between Bāṇa and Vināyaka; the battle between Vināyaka and Rāhu. The engaged combat between the lords of the gaṇas and the lords of the Dānavas.
In the one hundred and thirty-seventh chapter:

7.20.s: pramathāsurasainyanāyakānāṃ vīrāṇāṃ tumulaṃ dvandvayuddham . rathagajavājipādātānāṃ dāruṇaḥ sannipātaḥ .
7.20.d: प्रमथासुरसैन्यनायकानां वीराणां तुमुलं द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् . रथगजवाजिपादातानां दारुणः सन्निपातः .
7.20.m: The tumultuous single combats of the heroic commanders of the pramatha and asura armies. The terrible collision of chariots, elephants, horses, and foot soldiers.
In the one hundred and thirty-eighth chapter:

7.20.s: pramathāsurasainyayormahatā vegenānyonyamākramaṇam . ghoraḥ saṃgrāmaḥ, nandino jambhakujambhābhyāṃ dāruṇaṃ yuddham, kujambhavadhaḥ .
7.20.d: प्रमथासुरसैन्ययोर्महता वेगेनान्योन्यमाक्रमणम् . घोरः संग्रामः, नन्दिनो जम्भकुजम्भाभ्यां दारुणं युद्धम्, कुजम्भवधः .
7.20.m: The mutual assault of the pramatha and asura armies with tremendous momentum. A frightful battle; Nandin's ferocious fight with Jambha and Kujambha; the slaying of Kujambha.
In the one hundred and thirty-ninth chapter:

7.20.s: kruddhena jambhena nandinaṃ prati dāruṇaparighaprakṣepaṇam . śaṃkukarṇena javānmadhyemārgaṃ tatparighapragrahaṇam . śaṃkukarṇasya parighamudyamya jambhaṃ prati dhāvanam, mahān kolāhalaḥ . tadyuddhadarśanalālasayā sāndhakānāṃ pramathāsurasainyapravīrāṇāṃ tadānīṃ kalahād viramya kautūhalena tatra tathaivāvasthānam .
7.20.d: क्रुद्धेन जम्भेन नन्दिनं प्रति दारुणपरिघप्रक्षेपणम् . शंकुकर्णेन जवान्मध्येमार्गं तत्परिघप्रग्रहणम् . शंकुकर्णस्य परिघमुद्यम्य जम्भं प्रति धावनम्, महान् कोलाहलः . तद्युद्धदर्शनलालसया सान्धकानां प्रमथासुरसैन्यप्रवीराणां तदानीं कलहाद् विरम्य कौतूहलेन तत्र तथैवावस्थानम् .
7.20.m: Enraged, Jambha's hurling of a dread iron club toward Nandin. Śaṅkukarṇa's swift catching of that iron club midway on its path. Śaṅkukarṇa's charging toward Jambha brandishing the iron club; a great tumult. Eager to witness that duel, the warriors of the pramatha and asura armies, together with Andhaka, desisting from their fighting at that moment and remaining right there in curiosity.
In the one hundred and fortieth chapter:

7.20.s: jambhamuddiśya dhāvantaṃ śakukarṇaṃ prati vṛtrasyābhidhāvanam . vṛtraśaṃkukarṇayordāruṇaṃ yuddham .
7.20.d: जम्भमुद्दिश्य धावन्तं शकुकर्णं प्रति वृत्रस्याभिधावनम् . वृत्रशंकुकर्णयोर्दारुणं युद्धम् .
7.20.m: Vṛtra's charging toward Śaṅkukarṇa who was rushing against Jambha. The ferocious battle between Vṛtra and Śaṅkukarṇa.
In the one hundred and forty-first chapter:

7.20.s: vṛtrasya parākramaḥ, viṭpativṛtrayoryuddham . viṭpatiṃ prati daityavīrāṇāṃ sambhūyākramaṇam, pramathāsuravīrāṇāmati- dāruṇaṃ yuddham .
7.20.d: वृत्रस्य पराक्रमः, विट्पतिवृत्रयोर्युद्धम् . विट्पतिं प्रति दैत्यवीराणां सम्भूयाक्रमणम्, प्रमथासुरवीराणामति- दारुणं युद्धम् .
7.20.m: Vṛtra's valor; the battle between Viṭpati and Vṛtra. The Daitya warriors joining forces to attack Viṭpati; the exceedingly ferocious battle between the warriors of the pramathas and asuras.
In the one hundred and forty-second chapter:
The valor of Kārttasvana; the confounding of the pramathas by Kārttasvana; the battle between Viṭpati and Kārttasvana; the slaying of Kārttasvana.
In the one hundred and forty-third chapter:

7.20.s: viṭpatiṃ prati kruddhānāṃ prahlādādyasuravīrāṇāmabhyākramaṇam . tad dṛṣṭvā somanandyādipramukhagaṇeśvarāṇāṃ pratyākrama- ṇam . saṃsaktānāṃ pramathāsuravīrāṇāṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ yuddham .
7.20.d: विट्पतिं प्रति क्रुद्धानां प्रह्लादाद्यसुरवीराणामभ्याक्रमणम् . तद् दृष्ट्वा सोमनन्द्यादिप्रमुखगणेश्वराणां प्रत्याक्रम- णम् . संसक्तानां प्रमथासुरवीराणां भीषणं युद्धम् .
7.20.m: The assault toward Viṭpati by the enraged asura warriors headed by Prahlāda. Seeing that, the counter-attack by the prominent lords of the gaṇas headed by Somanandin. The fearsome combat of the closely joined pramatha and asura warriors.
In chapter one hundred forty-four:
The tumultuous close combat of the Pramatha and Asura warriors; the slaying of Huṇḍa and Tuhuṇḍa by Vināyaka.
In chapter one hundred forty-five:

7.20.s: pramathāsurāṇāṃ saṃkulaṃ yuddham . jambhavadhaḥ, asuragaṇeśvarāṇāṃ mahānsannipātaḥ . svayaṃprabheṇa dānavasainyasāgarapramathanam. andhakavirocanayorvimukhīkaraṇam . vimukhībhūtasyāndhakasya śukrasakāśe gamanam .
7.20.d: प्रमथासुराणां संकुलं युद्धम् . जम्भवधः, असुरगणेश्वराणां महान्सन्निपातः . स्वयंप्रभेण दानवसैन्यसागरप्रमथनम्. अन्धकविरोचनयोर्विमुखीकरणम् . विमुखीभूतस्यान्धकस्य शुक्रसकाशे गमनम् .
7.20.m: The chaotic battle of the Pramathas and Asuras; the slaying of Jambha; the great clash of the Asura chiefs; the churning of the ocean of the Dānava army by Svayaṃprabha; the routing of Andhaka and Virocana; the retreat of the routed Andhaka to the presence of Śukra.
In chapter one hundred forty-six:

7.20.s: andhakena śukrasavidhe dīnamanasā duḥkhanivedanam . śukreṇāndhakasya samāśvāsanam . raṇe nipatitānāṃ dānavavīrāṇāṃ śukreṇa samutthāpanam . pramathāsuravīrāṇāṃ punarbhīmanādaḥ pratisamāgamaḥ .
7.20.d: अन्धकेन शुक्रसविधे दीनमनसा दुःखनिवेदनम् . शुक्रेणान्धकस्य समाश्वासनम् . रणे निपतितानां दानववीराणां शुक्रेण समुत्थापनम् . प्रमथासुरवीराणां पुनर्भीमनादः प्रतिसमागमः .
7.20.m: Andhaka's miserable reporting of his sorrow in Śukra's presence; Śukra's consoling of Andhaka; Śukra's revival of the Dānava warriors fallen in battle; the renewed terrible roar and clash of the Pramatha and Asura warriors.
In chapter one hundred forty-seven:

7.20.s: amuragaṇeśvarāṇāmatibhairavaḥ saṃghaṭṭaḥ, jambhavināyakayuddham . pramathāsurāṇāmāścaryakaraṃ yuddham . nandinā mahādevāya lokātiśāyi bhārgavakarma nivedanam . mahādevājñāyā nandinā haṭhāt śukramapahṛtya tasya tatsamīpe upasthāpanam .mahādevena sajīvasya ( jīvataḥ) śukrasya nigiraṇam .
7.20.d: अमुरगणेश्वराणामतिभैरवः संघट्टः, जम्भविनायकयुद्धम् . प्रमथासुराणामाश्चर्यकरं युद्धम् . नन्दिना महादेवाय लोकातिशायि भार्गवकर्म निवेदनम् . महादेवाज्ञाया नन्दिना हठात् शुक्रमपहृत्य तस्य तत्समीपे उपस्थापनम् .महादेवेन सजीवस्य ( जीवतः) शुक्रस्य निगिरणम् .
7.20.m: The exceedingly terrible encounter of the Asura chiefs; the duel between Jambha and Vināyaka; the wondrous battle of the Pramathas and Asuras; Nandin's reporting to Mahādeva of the Bhārgava's world-transcending deed; Nandin's forceful abduction of Śukra by Mahādeva's command and presenting him before him; Mahādeva's swallowing of Śukra alive.
In chapter one hundred forty-eight:

7.20.s: śukrepahṛtendhakasya viṣādaḥ, gaṇadānavānāṃ punarbhīṣaṇaṃ yuddham . nandinaṃ prati jambhasya gajenābhiyānam . vināyakena jambhagajasya madhyemārgaṃ vinipātanam, vināyakasya jambhakujambhābhyāṃ dāruṇaṃ yuddham . vināyakasāhāyyārtha- mupasthitānāṃ gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ dānavavīraiḥ saha saṃkulaṃ yuddham .
7.20.d: शुक्रेपहृतेन्धकस्य विषादः, गणदानवानां पुनर्भीषणं युद्धम् . नन्दिनं प्रति जम्भस्य गजेनाभियानम् . विनायकेन जम्भगजस्य मध्येमार्गं विनिपातनम्, विनायकस्य जम्भकुजम्भाभ्यां दारुणं युद्धम् . विनायकसाहाय्यार्थ- मुपस्थितानां गणेश्वराणां दानववीरैः सह संकुलं युद्धम् .
7.20.m: Andhaka's dejection at Śukra's abduction; the renewed dreadful battle between the Gaṇas and Dānavas; Jambha's advance on an elephant against Nandin; Vināyaka's felling of Jambha's elephant midway; Vināyaka's fierce fight with Jambha and Kujambha; the confused battle of the Gaṇa chiefs who arrived to aid Vināyaka with the Dānava warriors.
In chapter one hundred forty-nine:

7.20.s: andhakena tadanuyāyidānavavīraiśca pramathagaṇānāmupari dāruṇaśastrāstravarṣaṇam . dānavavīraiḥ pramathānāṃ kadanam, rudradvārapālādīnāṃ dānavaiḥ saha saṃgharṣaḥ .
7.20.d: अन्धकेन तदनुयायिदानववीरैश्च प्रमथगणानामुपरि दारुणशस्त्रास्त्रवर्षणम् . दानववीरैः प्रमथानां कदनम्, रुद्रद्वारपालादीनां दानवैः सह संघर्षः .
7.20.m: The showering of terrible weapons and missiles upon the Pramatha hosts by Andhaka and the Dānava warriors who followed him; the slaughter of the Pramathas by the Dānava warriors; the clash of the doorkeepers of Rudra and others with the Dānavas.
In chapter one hundred fifty:

7.20.s: rudrodarāntarbhrāmyamāṇasya vivaśasya śukrasya bahuvidhavicitralokadarśanam . varṣaśatānantaraṃ mahādevaprasādāt śukrasya śukravalliṅgānniḥsaraṇam . śukramārgeṇa tathāniḥsaraṇāt bhārgavasya śukratvaṃ mahādevaputratvañca . śukranirmukte- rdarśanāddānavasainye mahān harṣaḥ, pramathāsurāṇāṃ punarbhīṣaṇaḥ saṃgharṣaḥ . pramathaiḥ samarditānāṃ ( pūrvameva) sāgarasamā- śrayaṇam . yuddhādapasṛtya sāgaraṃ śritāt dānavān prati śukrasya śāpaḥ, śukreṇāndhakasya samāśvāsanam . śukreṇa saṃrakṣitasyāndhakasya dviguṇenotsāhena yuddhe pravṛttiḥ . andhakena śastraprahārairgaṇeśvarāṇāṃ stabdhīkaraṇam . gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ dānavaiḥ saha punarbhayānakaṃ yuddham .
7.20.d: रुद्रोदरान्तर्भ्राम्यमाणस्य विवशस्य शुक्रस्य बहुविधविचित्रलोकदर्शनम् . वर्षशतानन्तरं महादेवप्रसादात् शुक्रस्य शुक्रवल्लिङ्गान्निःसरणम् . शुक्रमार्गेण तथानिःसरणात् भार्गवस्य शुक्रत्वं महादेवपुत्रत्वञ्च . शुक्रनिर्मुक्ते- र्दर्शनाद्दानवसैन्ये महान् हर्षः, प्रमथासुराणां पुनर्भीषणः संघर्षः . प्रमथैः समर्दितानां ( पूर्वमेव) सागरसमा- श्रयणम् . युद्धादपसृत्य सागरं श्रितात् दानवान् प्रति शुक्रस्य शापः, शुक्रेणान्धकस्य समाश्वासनम् . शुक्रेण संरक्षितस्यान्धकस्य द्विगुणेनोत्साहेन युद्धे प्रवृत्तिः . अन्धकेन शस्त्रप्रहारैर्गणेश्वराणां स्तब्धीकरणम् . गणेश्वराणां दानवैः सह पुनर्भयानकं युद्धम् .
7.20.m: Helpless Śukra's vision of various wondrous worlds while wandering inside Rudra's belly; after a hundred years, through Mahādeva's grace, Śukra's emergence from the liṅga like semen; because of thus emerging through the path of semen, the Bhārgava's condition of being Śukra ('semen') and son of Mahādeva; great joy in the Dānava army upon seeing Śukra's release; the renewed dreadful clash of the Pramathas and Asuras; the taking refuge in the ocean by those previously crushed by the Pramathas; Śukra's curse upon the Dānavas who withdrew from the battle and took refuge in the ocean; Śukra's consoling of Andhaka; Andhaka, protected by Śukra, engaging in battle with redoubled zeal; Andhaka's paralyzing of the Gaṇa chiefs with weapon strikes; the renewed terrible battle of the Gaṇa chiefs with the Dānavas.
In chapter one hundred fifty-one:

7.20.s: andhakabalārditānāṃ pramathānāṃ sāhāyyārthaṃ brahmaṇo vacanāt śakrādyakhiladevānāṃ yuddhabhūmāvataraṇam, pramathairdava- gaṇaiśca dānavabalānāṃ vyākulīkaraṇam, andhakasya rudramuddiśya vegenābhisaraṇam, nandinā tasya vāraṇam, nandyadhankayo- rdāruṇaṃ yuddham, andhakasya virathībhāvaḥ, rathāntarārohaṇam, punaḥ sudāruṇayuddhaprasaktiḥ .
7.20.d: अन्धकबलार्दितानां प्रमथानां साहाय्यार्थं ब्रह्मणो वचनात् शक्राद्यखिलदेवानां युद्धभूमावतरणम्, प्रमथैर्दव- गणैश्च दानवबलानां व्याकुलीकरणम्, अन्धकस्य रुद्रमुद्दिश्य वेगेनाभिसरणम्, नन्दिना तस्य वारणम्, नन्द्यधन्कयो- र्दारुणं युद्धम्, अन्धकस्य विरथीभावः, रथान्तरारोहणम्, पुनः सुदारुणयुद्धप्रसक्तिः .
7.20.m: At the word of Brahmā, all the gods headed by Śakra descending to the battlefield to aid the Pramathas who were distressed by Andhaka's army; the confounding of the Dānava forces by the Pramathas and the hosts of gods; Andhaka's swift rush toward Rudra; Nandin's checking him; the fierce duel between Nandin and Andhaka; Andhaka's being deprived of his chariot; his mounting another chariot; his engaging again in a most terrible battle.
In chapter one hundred fifty-two:

7.20.s: devadānavānāṃ dvandvayuddham, nandinā sahāndhakasyāti bhayaṃkaraṃ yuddham, andhakasya māyāyuddham, ekenāndhakena sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ pramathagaṇeśvarāṇāṃ ca vyākulīkaraṇam .
7.20.d: देवदानवानां द्वन्द्वयुद्धम्, नन्दिना सहान्धकस्याति भयंकरं युद्धम्, अन्धकस्य मायायुद्धम्, एकेनान्धकेन सर्वेषां देवानां प्रमथगणेश्वराणां च व्याकुलीकरणम् .
7.20.m: The single combats between gods and Dānavas; the exceedingly dreadful battle of Andhaka with Nandin; Andhaka's illusory warfare; the confounding of all the gods and Pramatha chiefs by Andhaka alone.
In chapter one hundred fifty-three:

7.20.s: andhakasya pramathagaṇeśvaraissahātidāruṇaṃ yuddham . pramathairdānavānāṃ pramathanam, yuddhabhūmau dustaraśoṇitanadīpravṛttiḥ . devadānavānāṃ samākulamadbhutaṃ yuddham .
7.20.d: अन्धकस्य प्रमथगणेश्वरैस्सहातिदारुणं युद्धम् . प्रमथैर्दानवानां प्रमथनम्, युद्धभूमौ दुस्तरशोणितनदीप्रवृत्तिः . देवदानवानां समाकुलमद्भुतं युद्धम् .
7.20.m: Andhaka's most fierce battle with the Pramatha chiefs; the crushing of the Dānavas by the Pramathas; the flow of an impassable river of blood on the battlefield; the chaotic and wondrous battle between the gods and Dānavas.
In chapter one hundred fifty-four:

7.20.s: kruddhānāṃ dānaveśvārāṇāṃ nandinaṃ prati abhidravaṇam . nandino dānavavīraiḥ saha bhīṣaṇaṃ yuddham . nandinā śareṇa balernipātanam . balau nipatite dānavānāṃ yuddhādvidravaṇam . andhakena dānavendrāṇāṃ saṃbodhanam, andhakavacasā dānavānāṃ punaryuddhāya pratinivartanam, andhakasya nandinaṃ prati rathenābhiyānam, nandyandhakayostumulaṃ dvairathaṃ (yuddham), andhakasya yuddhedbhutaḥ parākramaḥ, andhakaśaravedhavyākulānāṃ devagaṇānāṃ pramathagaṇeśvarāṇāñca nandina- mekaṃ vimucya sarveṣāṃ yuddhādvidravaṇam, tatosurabale ghoraḥ sarvaprāṇikṛtaḥ sabāditraravo mahān siṃhanāda .
7.20.d: क्रुद्धानां दानवेश्वाराणां नन्दिनं प्रति अभिद्रवणम् . नन्दिनो दानववीरैः सह भीषणं युद्धम् . नन्दिना शरेण बलेर्निपातनम् . बलौ निपतिते दानवानां युद्धाद्विद्रवणम् . अन्धकेन दानवेन्द्राणां संबोधनम्, अन्धकवचसा दानवानां पुनर्युद्धाय प्रतिनिवर्तनम्, अन्धकस्य नन्दिनं प्रति रथेनाभियानम्, नन्द्यन्धकयोस्तुमुलं द्वैरथं (युद्धम्), अन्धकस्य युद्धेद्भुतः पराक्रमः, अन्धकशरवेधव्याकुलानां देवगणानां प्रमथगणेश्वराणाञ्च नन्दिन- मेकं विमुच्य सर्वेषां युद्धाद्विद्रवणम्, ततोसुरबले घोरः सर्वप्राणिकृतः सबादित्ररवो महान् सिंहनाद .
7.20.m: The rushing of the enraged Dānava lords against Nandin; Nandin's dreadful battle with the Dānava warriors; Nandin's felling of Bali with an arrow; the flight of the Dānavas from the battle when Bali fell; Andhaka's address to the Dānava chiefs; the return of the Dānavas to battle at Andhaka's word; Andhaka's advance by chariot against Nandin; the tumultuous chariot duel between Nandin and Andhaka; Andhaka's wondrous prowess in the battle; the flight from battle of all the hosts of gods and Pramatha chiefs, distressed by the piercing of Andhaka's arrows, leaving Nandin alone; then in the Asura army, a terrible and great lion's roar made by all creatures along with the sound of musical instruments.
In chapter one hundred fifty-five:

7.20.s: andhakena bhagnapauruṣāṇāṃ devānāṃ śūlapāṇeḥ śaraṇe gamanam, devānāṃ prārthanayā mahādevena śūlaṃ saṃpreṣya tena hṛdi viddhasyāndhakasya svasamīpa ānāyanam, śūlaviddhāndhakahṛdayaviniḥsṛtaśoṇitabindubhyondhakasarūpāṇāṃ yodhānāṃ samutpattiḥ, mahādevājñayā mātṛbhisteṣāṃ bhakṣaṇam . andhakasya varṣasahasraṃ sūryatejasā śūlāgre pacanam . tato janitasātvikabhāvenāndhakena candrārdhamauleḥ stavanam, sutuṣṭena mahādevenāndhakāya gāṇapatyapradānam, brahmakṛto rudrastavaḥ .
