7.20.d: अन्धकेन भग्नपौरुषाणां देवानां शूलपाणेः शरणे गमनम्, देवानां प्रार्थनया महादेवेन शूलं संप्रेष्य तेन हृदि विद्धस्यान्धकस्य स्वसमीप आनायनम्, शूलविद्धान्धकहृदयविनिःसृतशोणितबिन्दुभ्योन्धकसरूपाणां योधानां समुत्पत्तिः, महादेवाज्ञया मातृभिस्तेषां भक्षणम् . अन्धकस्य वर्षसहस्रं सूर्यतेजसा शूलाग्रे पचनम् . ततो जनितसात्विकभावेनान्धकेन चन्द्रार्धमौलेः स्तवनम्, सुतुष्टेन महादेवेनान्धकाय गाणपत्यप्रदानम्, ब्रह्मकृतो रुद्रस्तवः .
7.20.m: The gods whose prowess was broken by Andhaka going to the trident-bearing Lord for refuge; at the prayer of the gods, Mahādeva's dispatching the trident, piercing Andhaka in the chest with it, and bringing him near himself; the springing forth of warriors resembling Andhaka from the drops of blood issuing from Andhaka's trident-pierced chest; by Mahādeva's command, their devouring by the Mothers; Andhaka's roasting on the tip of the trident by the solar blaze for a thousand years; then, through the arising of a pure disposition, Andhaka's praise of the Lord with the crescent moon on his crest; Mahādeva, well pleased, conferring Gaṇa-chieftainship upon Andhaka; the hymn of praise to Rudra made by Brahmā.
In chapter one hundred fifty-six:

7.20.s: andhakamathanānantaraṃ mahādevena devānāṃ gaṇānāñca yathocitamarcanena visarjanam .
7.20.d: अन्धकमथनानन्तरं महादेवेन देवानां गणानाञ्च यथोचितमर्चनेन विसर्जनम् .
7.20.m: After the subduing of Andhaka, Mahādeva's dismissal of the gods and Gaṇas with due worship.
In chapter one hundred fifty-seven:

7.20.s: devagaṇavisarjanānantaraṃ śaṅkarasya svabhavanapraveśaḥ . gaṇapravarīkṛtasyāndhakasya mahādevena pārvatyāḥ svasutatvakathanam . pārvatyā cāndhakasya putreti saṃbodhanam . andhakakṛtā pārvatīstutiḥ . andhakaṃ prati pārvatyā anugrahaḥ .
7.20.d: देवगणविसर्जनानन्तरं शङ्करस्य स्वभवनप्रवेशः . गणप्रवरीकृतस्यान्धकस्य महादेवेन पार्वत्याः स्वसुतत्वकथनम् . पार्वत्या चान्धकस्य पुत्रेति संबोधनम् . अन्धककृता पार्वतीस्तुतिः . अन्धकं प्रति पार्वत्या अनुग्रहः .
7.20.m: After dismissing the hosts of gods, Śaṃkara's entrance into his own abode; Mahādeva's declaring to Pārvatī that Andhaka, made chief of the Gaṇas, was her own son; Pārvatī addressing Andhaka as 'son'; the hymn of praise to Pārvatī offered by Andhaka; Pārvatī's grace toward Andhaka.
In chapter one hundred fifty-eight:

7.20.s: mahādevasyāgrataḥ pārvatyāḥ putra viṣaye jijñāsā, mahādevakṛtaṃ putramahimavarṇanam . koṣṭhajāt putrād bhūmiruhasya (kṛtakaputratvam), putrasya śreṣṭhataratvakathanam, putraśabdanirūktiḥ, tarūṇāṃ putrapratikṛtitvam , taruputrakagrahaṇa- vidhikathamam, pārvatyā mahādevasavidhe aśokataruputragrahaṇecchāprakaṭanam, mahādevena tadanumodanam, prasaṅgāt strīṇāṃ bhartranujñayaiva dharmādyanupṭhānādhikāritāyāḥ kathanam .
7.20.d: महादेवस्याग्रतः पार्वत्याः पुत्र विषये जिज्ञासा, महादेवकृतं पुत्रमहिमवर्णनम् . कोष्ठजात् पुत्राद् भूमिरुहस्य (कृतकपुत्रत्वम्), पुत्रस्य श्रेष्ठतरत्वकथनम्, पुत्रशब्दनिरूक्तिः, तरूणां पुत्रप्रतिकृतित्वम् , तरुपुत्रकग्रहण- विधिकथमम्, पार्वत्या महादेवसविधे अशोकतरुपुत्रग्रहणेच्छाप्रकटनम्, महादेवेन तदनुमोदनम्, प्रसङ्गात् स्त्रीणां भर्त्रनुज्ञयैव धर्माद्यनुप्ठानाधिकारितायाः कथनम् .
7.20.m: Pārvatī's inquiry before Mahādeva regarding a son; Mahādeva's description of the greatness of a son; the statement that a tree is superior even to an adopted son born of one's own womb; the etymological explanation of the word 'putra'; trees serving as substitutes for sons; the statement of the rite of adopting a tree as a son; Pārvatī's expression of her desire to adopt an Aśoka tree as a son before Mahādeva; Mahādeva's approval of it; and incidentally, the statement that women are entitled to perform religious duties and the like only with their husband's permission.
In the one hundred fifty-ninth chapter:

7.20.s: pārvatyā bhaśokataruputragrahaṇotsavopakramaḥ, mahādevājñayā aśokatarupotakasannidhau utsavasthale sumālināmnā piṅgalayakṣeṇa yathāvaśyakānnādisayojanena sāmagrīsajjīkaraṇam, mahādevājñayā viprāgryāṇāṃ lokapālādīnāṃ cāmantraṇārthaṃ nandinaḥ prasthānam, nandinaḥ prathamato varuṇālayagamanam tata udayācalagamanam .
7.20.d: पार्वत्या भशोकतरुपुत्रग्रहणोत्सवोपक्रमः, महादेवाज्ञया अशोकतरुपोतकसन्निधौ उत्सवस्थले सुमालिनाम्ना पिङ्गलयक्षेण यथावश्यकान्नादिसयोजनेन सामग्रीसज्जीकरणम्, महादेवाज्ञया विप्राग्र्याणां लोकपालादीनां चामन्त्रणार्थं नन्दिनः प्रस्थानम्, नन्दिनः प्रथमतो वरुणालयगमनम् तत उदयाचलगमनम् .
7.20.m: The commencement of the festival of adopting an Aśoka tree as a son by Pārvatī; by order of Mahādeva, the preparation of materials at the festive site near the young Aśoka tree by the tawny Yakṣa named Sumālin, supplying the required food and other necessities; Nandin's departure by Mahādeva's command to invite the foremost brahmins, world-protectors, and others; and Nandin's going first to the abode of Varuṇa, and thence to Mount Udaya.
160. In the one hundred sixtieth chapter:

7.20.s: tato nandino yathākramaṃ sūrya - dhaneśa - yama - śakra - lokagamanam .
7.20.d: ततो नन्दिनो यथाक्रमं सूर्य - धनेश - यम - शक्र - लोकगमनम् .
7.20.m: Then, Nandin's sequential journey to the realms of Sūrya, Dhaneśa, Yama, and Śakra.
161. In the one hundred sixty-first chapter:

7.20.s: śakralokānnandino brahmalokagamanam, tataḥ kṣīrasāgaragamanam divi bhuvi ca yathopadṛṣṭaśrutān viprānāmantrya nandino mandare pratyāvartanam .
7.20.d: शक्रलोकान्नन्दिनो ब्रह्मलोकगमनम्, ततः क्षीरसागरगमनम् दिवि भुवि च यथोपदृष्टश्रुतान् विप्रानामन्त्र्य नन्दिनो मन्दरे प्रत्यावर्तनम् .
7.20.m: From Śakra's realm, Nandin's journey to Brahmaloka; then his going to the Ocean of Milk; and having invited the brahmins seen and heard of in heaven and on earth, Nandin's return to Mount Mandara.
162. In the one hundred sixty-second chapter:

7.20.s: nandinaḥ kāryāt prasannena mahādevena pārvatyā anumodena nandine varadānam . sāyaṃ sandhyopāsanānantaraṃ sagaṇasya somasya mahādevasya harṣānnṛtyācaraṇam . aśokataruputragrahaṇārthaṃ mahādevājñayā pārvatyāstadrātrau yathoktaniyamenāvasthānam, paredyuḥ prabhāta eva pārvatyā bhartrā saha aśokatarupotasannidhau gamanam, brahmādidevānāṃ maharṣi- pravarāṇāmanyeṣāṃ ca mahataḥ samājasya tatropasthitiḥ, umayā ' śokatarupotakasya vastrabhūṣādinā samalaṃkaraṇam . viprāṇāṃ vedaghoṣaiḥ puṇyādvaśabdaiśca guñjāyamāne harṣollāsayukte mahotsave gṛhītaviprānujñayāmayā savidhyaśoka- tarugrahaṇam, somena śivena samyaksabhājitānāṃ satkṛtānāṃ pūjitānāṃ tarpitānāṃ viprāṇāṃ devādīnāṃ ca svasvasthānagamanam, aśokataruputragrahaṇamahotsavasamāptiḥ .
7.20.d: नन्दिनः कार्यात् प्रसन्नेन महादेवेन पार्वत्या अनुमोदेन नन्दिने वरदानम् . सायं सन्ध्योपासनानन्तरं सगणस्य सोमस्य महादेवस्य हर्षान्नृत्याचरणम् . अशोकतरुपुत्रग्रहणार्थं महादेवाज्ञया पार्वत्यास्तद्रात्रौ यथोक्तनियमेनावस्थानम्, परेद्युः प्रभात एव पार्वत्या भर्त्रा सह अशोकतरुपोतसन्निधौ गमनम्, ब्रह्मादिदेवानां महर्षि- प्रवराणामन्येषां च महतः समाजस्य तत्रोपस्थितिः, उमया ' शोकतरुपोतकस्य वस्त्रभूषादिना समलंकरणम् . विप्राणां वेदघोषैः पुण्याद्वशब्दैश्च गुञ्जायमाने हर्षोल्लासयुक्ते महोत्सवे गृहीतविप्रानुज्ञयामया सविध्यशोक- तरुग्रहणम्, सोमेन शिवेन सम्यक्सभाजितानां सत्कृतानां पूजितानां तर्पितानां विप्राणां देवादीनां च स्वस्वस्थानगमनम्, अशोकतरुपुत्रग्रहणमहोत्सवसमाप्तिः .
7.20.m: Mahādeva, pleased with Nandin's work, bestows a boon upon Nandin with Pārvatī's assent; after the evening twilight worship, Mahādeva, accompanied by Umā and his gaṇas, dances with joy; by Mahādeva's command, Pārvatī observes the prescribed vows that night in order to adopt the Aśoka tree as a son; the next day, at dawn itself, Pārvatī goes with her husband near the young Aśoka tree; the arrival there of Brahmā and the other gods, the foremost great seers, and a vast assembly of others; Umā's decorating the young Aśoka tree with garments, ornaments, and the like; amid the great festival filled with joy and delight, resounding with the Vedic chants and auspicious shouts of the brahmins, Umā, having received permission from the brahmins, adopts the nearby Aśoka tree according to rite; the brahmins, gods, and others, properly honored, entertained, worshiped, and gratified by Śiva along with Umā, depart to their respective abodes; the conclusion of the great festival of adopting the Aśoka tree as a son.
163. In the one hundred sixty-third chapter:

7.20.s: vyāsasya prārthanayā punaḥ sanatkumārakṛtaḥ pūrvaprakṛtaskandotpattivivaraṇārambhaḥ vahninā śambhutejaso gaṅgāyā saṅkrāmaṇam, tadugratejo dhārayitumakṣamayā gaṅgayā tasya śvetaparvataśikharavarttiśarastambe samutsarjanam, tataśca skandotpattiḥ . skandasya . viśvāmitreṇa jātakarmasaṃpādanam, kṛttikādīnāṃ mātṝṇāṃ ca tatropasthitiḥ, skandena giriśṛṅgasya pātanam śakrasya tatrāgamanam, śakraskandavivādaḥ, śakradarpadalanam, śakrakṛtā senāpatyaṃ grahaṇaprārthanā, sāmasya śivasyāgamaḥ, vahnisvāhāgaṅgādīnāṃ ca tatropāsthatiḥ, skandena ṣoḍhāmūrttidhāraṇam, mahādevena skandāya caturvidha strigrāmapradānam, pārvatyā vahnyādibhiśca tasmai vividhavastrālaṃkārādipradāna. brahyādisarvadivaukasā tatrāgamanam, devānāṃ tārakasaṃhārāya skandasya senāpatyebhiṣecanārthaṃ śivasavidhe prārthanā, mahādevena tadanujñānam .
7.20.d: व्यासस्य प्रार्थनया पुनः सनत्कुमारकृतः पूर्वप्रकृतस्कन्दोत्पत्तिविवरणारम्भः वह्निना शम्भुतेजसो गङ्गाया सङ्क्रामणम्, तदुग्रतेजो धारयितुमक्षमया गङ्गया तस्य श्वेतपर्वतशिखरवर्त्तिशरस्तम्बे समुत्सर्जनम्, ततश्च स्कन्दोत्पत्तिः . स्कन्दस्य . विश्वामित्रेण जातकर्मसंपादनम्, कृत्तिकादीनां मातॄणां च तत्रोपस्थितिः, स्कन्देन गिरिशृङ्गस्य पातनम् शक्रस्य तत्रागमनम्, शक्रस्कन्दविवादः, शक्रदर्पदलनम्, शक्रकृता सेनापत्यं ग्रहणप्रार्थना, सामस्य शिवस्यागमः, वह्निस्वाहागङ्गादीनां च तत्रोपास्थतिः, स्कन्देन षोढामूर्त्तिधारणम्, महादेवेन स्कन्दाय चतुर्विध स्त्रिग्रामप्रदानम्, पार्वत्या वह्न्यादिभिश्च तस्मै विविधवस्त्रालंकारादिप्रदान. ब्रह्यादिसर्वदिवौकसा तत्रागमनम्, देवानां तारकसंहाराय स्कन्दस्य सेनापत्येभिषेचनार्थं शिवसविधे प्रार्थना, महादेवेन तदनुज्ञानम् .
7.20.m: At the request of Vyāsa, Sanatkumāra again begins the previously broached account of Skanda's birth; the transfer of Śambhu's fiery seed to Gaṅgā by Fire; Gaṅgā, unable to bear that fierce fiery energy, deposits it in a thicket of reed-grass situated on the peak of the white mountain, and from that comes the birth of Skanda; Viśvāmitra's performance of the birth rites for Skanda; the arrival there of the Kṛttikās and other mothers; Skanda's toppling of the mountain peak; Śakra's arrival there, the dispute between Śakra and Skanda, and the crushing of Śakra's pride; Śakra's request that he accept generalship of the army; the arrival of Śiva with Umā; the presence there of Fire, Svāhā, Gaṅgā, and others; Skanda's assuming a sixfold form; Mahādeva's grant of the four kinds of female hosts to Skanda; the presentation of various garments, ornaments, and other gifts to him by Pārvatī, Fire, and others; the arrival there of all the celestials beginning with Brahmā; the gods' petition before Śiva for Skanda's consecration to generalship for the slaying of Tāraka; and Mahādeva's granting permission for it.
164. In the one hundred sixty-fourth chapter:

7.20.s: skandamādāya tasyābhiṣekārthaṃ brahmādīnāṃ samantapañcake sarasvatyāstīrabhūmāvāgamanam, tatra suvarṇakalaśasiṃhāsanā dīnāmupakaraṇānāṃ sajjīkaraṇam, gṛhītavividhopahārasya sarvalokasamājasya tatropasthitiḥ, bṛhaspaterācāryatve jvalanaṃ samidhya samagrābhiṣecanikavidhisamāpādanam, mahati samārohe jayavādyavedagītaghoṣaiḥ saha skandasya senāpatyebhiṣecanam, skandāya vividhopahārapradānam tasya vividhopakaraṇairalaṅkaraṇam, brahmādibhirakhilaistatro- pasthitaiḥ skandāya nānāpāriṣadapradānam, śivena pārvatyā ca svaputrāya nānārūpadharānekamahāpāriṣadapradānam . kauśikyā skandāyānekamātṛgaṇapradānam, evaṃ vividhopakaraṇaiḥ sajjībhūtasya skandasya tārakavijayāya prasthānopakramaḥ .
7.20.d: स्कन्दमादाय तस्याभिषेकार्थं ब्रह्मादीनां समन्तपञ्चके सरस्वत्यास्तीरभूमावागमनम्, तत्र सुवर्णकलशसिंहासना दीनामुपकरणानां सज्जीकरणम्, गृहीतविविधोपहारस्य सर्वलोकसमाजस्य तत्रोपस्थितिः, बृहस्पतेराचार्यत्वे ज्वलनं समिध्य समग्राभिषेचनिकविधिसमापादनम्, महति समारोहे जयवाद्यवेदगीतघोषैः सह स्कन्दस्य सेनापत्येभिषेचनम्, स्कन्दाय विविधोपहारप्रदानम् तस्य विविधोपकरणैरलङ्करणम्, ब्रह्मादिभिरखिलैस्तत्रो- पस्थितैः स्कन्दाय नानापारिषदप्रदानम्, शिवेन पार्वत्या च स्वपुत्राय नानारूपधरानेकमहापारिषदप्रदानम् . कौशिक्या स्कन्दायानेकमातृगणप्रदानम्, एवं विविधोपकरणैः सज्जीभूतस्य स्कन्दस्य तारकविजयाय प्रस्थानोपक्रमः .
7.20.m: Brahmā and the others, taking Skanda, arrive at Samantapañcaka on the bank of the Sarasvatī for his consecration; the preparation there of implements such as golden jars and a throne; the assembly of all the worlds arriving there bearing diverse offerings; with Bṛhaspati serving as priest and kindling the fire, the complete execution of the consecration rites; Skanda's consecration to the generalship in a grand celebration amid cheers of victory, musical instruments, and the sound of Vedic hymns; the giving of diverse offerings to Skanda, and his adornment with various paraphernalia; all those assembled, beginning with Brahmā, give various attendants to Skanda; Śiva and Pārvatī grant numerous great attendants of diverse forms to their son; Kauśikī gives multiple groups of mothers to Skanda; and thus equipped with diverse implements, Skanda's setting out to conquer Tāraka.
165. In the one hundred sixty-fifth chapter:

7.20.s: sannaddhasainyānāṃ surāṇāṃ skandaṃ purodhāya daityānpratyabhiyānam, tadvijñāya daityānāṃ sasaṃbhramaṃ sainya sannāhya yuddhārthaṃ nirgamanam devāsurasainyayostumulaḥ saṃgharṣaḥ, tārakasya yuddhārthamabhisaraṇam, skandatārakayoryuddham, tārakavadhaḥ, samastadaityasainyānāṃ vināśaḥ .
7.20.d: सन्नद्धसैन्यानां सुराणां स्कन्दं पुरोधाय दैत्यान्प्रत्यभियानम्, तद्विज्ञाय दैत्यानां ससंभ्रमं सैन्य सन्नाह्य युद्धार्थं निर्गमनम् देवासुरसैन्ययोस्तुमुलः संघर्षः, तारकस्य युद्धार्थमभिसरणम्, स्कन्दतारकयोर्युद्धम्, तारकवधः, समस्तदैत्यसैन्यानां विनाशः .
7.20.m: The gods with prepared armies march against the Daityas placing Skanda at their head; learning of this, the Daityas hastily arm their forces and march out for battle; a fierce clash ensues between the armies of the gods and Asuras; Tāraka advances for battle; the duel between Skanda and Tāraka; the slaying of Tāraka; and the destruction of the entire Daitya army.
166. In the one hundred sixty-sixth chapter:

7.20.s: pārvatyāḥ prārthanayā mahādevena svanāmnāmarthaprabodhanam (nāmanirvacanam) nāmoccāraṇamāhātmyakathanaṃ ca, śvetopākhyānam, bālyātprabhṛtyeva śvetasya vṛṣadhvajenanyā bhaktiḥ, viraktasya śvetasya rudrārādhanārthaṃ cirakāla tapaścaryā tapasi sthitasyaiva kṣīṇāyuṣaḥ prāptakālasya śvetasya nayanārthaṃ yamadūtānāmāgamanam, yamadūtadarśanāt trastasya śvetasya rudrānusmaraṇam, rudreṇa āsannamṛtyoḥ śvetasya rakṣārthaṃ tatsamīpe gaṇānāṃ preṣaṇam, svayaṃ yamasya tatrāgamaḥ, yamasya rudragaṇaiḥ saha vivādaḥ , śvetamādāya yamasya gaṇaiḥ saha rudrasamīpe gamanam, rudreṇa yamasya bhṛśaṃ bhartsanam, rudratya krodhadṛṣṭyā yamasya bhasmībhāvaḥ, śvetaṃ prati rudrasyānugrahaḥ, śvetaṃ mṛtyumukhādunmucya tasmai gāṇapatya- pradānam, sasurāṇāṃ devānāṃ prārthanayā mahādevena yamasya purarujjīvanama, śvetopākhyānopasaṃhāraḥ .
7.20.d: पार्वत्याः प्रार्थनया महादेवेन स्वनाम्नामर्थप्रबोधनम् (नामनिर्वचनम्) नामोच्चारणमाहात्म्यकथनं च, श्वेतोपाख्यानम्, बाल्यात्प्रभृत्येव श्वेतस्य वृषध्वजेनन्या भक्तिः, विरक्तस्य श्वेतस्य रुद्राराधनार्थं चिरकाल तपश्चर्या तपसि स्थितस्यैव क्षीणायुषः प्राप्तकालस्य श्वेतस्य नयनार्थं यमदूतानामागमनम्, यमदूतदर्शनात् त्रस्तस्य श्वेतस्य रुद्रानुस्मरणम्, रुद्रेण आसन्नमृत्योः श्वेतस्य रक्षार्थं तत्समीपे गणानां प्रेषणम्, स्वयं यमस्य तत्रागमः, यमस्य रुद्रगणैः सह विवादः , श्वेतमादाय यमस्य गणैः सह रुद्रसमीपे गमनम्, रुद्रेण यमस्य भृशं भर्त्सनम्, रुद्रत्य क्रोधदृष्ट्या यमस्य भस्मीभावः, श्वेतं प्रति रुद्रस्यानुग्रहः, श्वेतं मृत्युमुखादुन्मुच्य तस्मै गाणपत्य- प्रदानम्, ससुराणां देवानां प्रार्थनया महादेवेन यमस्य पुररुज्जीवनम, श्वेतोपाख्यानोपसंहारः .
7.20.m: At Pārvatī's request, Mahādeva explains the meanings of his names (etymology of the names) and recounts the māhātmya of uttering the names; the story of Śveta; Śveta's singular devotion to the bull-bannered [god] from his very childhood; dispassionate Śveta's long-term practice of austerities to worship Rudra; the arrival of Yama's messengers to take Śveta, whose lifespan had run out and whose time had come while still engaged in austerity; Śveta's recollection of Rudra upon seeing Yama's messengers in terror; Rudra's dispatch of the gaṇas to his side to protect Śveta whose death was imminent; the arrival of Yama himself there; Yama's dispute with the gaṇas of Rudra; Yama's departure with the gaṇas to Rudra's presence, taking Śveta along; Rudra's severe reprimand of Yama; Yama's reduction to ashes by Rudra's furious glance; Rudra's grace toward Śveta; releasing Śveta from the jaws of death and granting him leadership of the gaṇas; Mahādeva's revival of Yama at the request of the gods along with the immortals; the conclusion of the story of Śveta.
In the one hundred sixty-seventh chapter:

7.20.s: śivāyatanavarṇanam ādityabandhana (ādityarodhana), samākhyavindhyakūṭavartti tapaneśvaraprabhṛtinepālasya paśupatinātha sanātha़maikatuṅgādhipaśvarānta naikavidhapuṇyasthānānāṃ saṃkṣiptavarṇanam . avimuktakṣetratsya vārāṇasyāḥ savistaraṃ varṇanam .
7.20.d: शिवायतनवर्णनम् आदित्यबन्धन (आदित्यरोधन), समाख्यविन्ध्यकूटवर्त्ति तपनेश्वरप्रभृतिनेपालस्य पशुपतिनाथ सनाथ़मैकतुङ्गाधिपश्वरान्त नैकविधपुण्यस्थानानां संक्षिप्तवर्णनम् . अविमुक्तक्षेत्रत्स्य वाराणस्याः सविस्तरं वर्णनम् .
7.20.m: Description of the abodes of Śiva; brief description of various holy places, beginning with Tapaneśvara situated on the Vindhya peak known as Ādityabandhana (Ādityarodhana), and ending with Paśupatinātha, Lord of Nepal, and the Lord of Maikatuṅga; extensive description of the Avimuktakṣetra, Vārāṇasī.
In the one hundred sixty-eighth chapter:

7.20.s: traipuropākhyānopakramaḥ . tārakākṣavidyutprabhābhyāṃ saha mayasya tapaścaryā . pitāmahādvaraprāptiḥ . puratrayanirmāṇam . tripurāsurairdevān vijitya trailokyarājyakaraṇam . lokānāṃ pīḍanam . tripuravināśārthaṃ brahmādibhi kṛtā mahādevastutiḥ .
7.20.d: त्रैपुरोपाख्यानोपक्रमः . तारकाक्षविद्युत्प्रभाभ्यां सह मयस्य तपश्चर्या . पितामहाद्वरप्राप्तिः . पुरत्रयनिर्माणम् . त्रिपुरासुरैर्देवान् विजित्य त्रैलोक्यराज्यकरणम् . लोकानां पीडनम् . त्रिपुरविनाशार्थं ब्रह्मादिभि कृता महादेवस्तुतिः .
7.20.m: Commencement of the story of Tripura; Maya's practice of austerities together with Tārakākṣa and Vidyutprabha; obtaining a boon from the Grandfather [Brahmā]; construction of the three cities; the Tripura asuras conquering the gods and ruling over the three worlds; torment of the worlds; the praise of Mahādeva by Brahmā and others for the destruction of Tripura.
In the one hundred sixty-ninth chapter:

7.20.s: mahādevena devānāṃ samāśvāsanam . tripurasaṃhārārthaṃ mahādevasya kṛte devai rathakalpanam . tridevamayaśarakalpanā . brahmaṇaḥ sārathye śambhoḥ rathārohaṇam . nāradasya mayadidṛkṣayā tripure gamanam . śambhunā saha yuddhakaraṇāya nāradena mayasya protsāhanam . dānavānāṃ yuddhasannāhaḥ . kṛtayuddhasajjānāṃ dānavānāṃ śambhurathasya samīpe gamanam .
7.20.d: महादेवेन देवानां समाश्वासनम् . त्रिपुरसंहारार्थं महादेवस्य कृते देवै रथकल्पनम् . त्रिदेवमयशरकल्पना . ब्रह्मणः सारथ्ये शम्भोः रथारोहणम् . नारदस्य मयदिदृक्षया त्रिपुरे गमनम् . शम्भुना सह युद्धकरणाय नारदेन मयस्य प्रोत्साहनम् . दानवानां युद्धसन्नाहः . कृतयुद्धसज्जानां दानवानां शम्भुरथस्य समीपे गमनम् .
7.20.m: Mahādeva comforting the gods; the preparation of a chariot by the gods for Mahādeva for the destruction of Tripura; fashioning of an arrow consisting of the three gods; Śambhu mounting the chariot with Brahmā as his charioteer; Nārada going to Tripura desiring to see Maya; Nārada encouraging Maya to wage battle with Śambhu; the dānavas' preparation for battle; the dānavas, equipped for battle, approaching Śambhu's chariot.
In the one hundred seventieth chapter:

7.20.s: śambho rathasya paścima sāgaramūrdhnyavasthitaṃ tripuraṃ pratyabhiyānam . gaṇadānavānāṃ tumulaṃ yuddham . yudhi nihatānāṃ dānavānāmamṛtasekena traipuraiḥ punarujjīvanam . brahmaṇo vijñaptyā śambhunā saṃkalpamātreṇa dānavānāmamṛtasya haraṇam . śambhunā tripuradāhārthaṃ śarakṣepaṇam . śarakṣepaṇasamakālameva śambhunā hā kaṣṭamiti uccaiḥ procya mayasya dahanādrakṣārthaṃ nandino mukhena (tripuraṃ didhakṣate) analāya sandeśapreṣaṇam . vahnivākyānmayasya tripurā- nniṣkramya pātāle gamanam . tripuradāhaḥ . mahādevena devānāṃ visarjanam . sagaṇasya mahādevasya kailāsa gamanam .
7.20.d: शम्भो रथस्य पश्चिम सागरमूर्ध्न्यवस्थितं त्रिपुरं प्रत्यभियानम् . गणदानवानां तुमुलं युद्धम् . युधि निहतानां दानवानाममृतसेकेन त्रैपुरैः पुनरुज्जीवनम् . ब्रह्मणो विज्ञप्त्या शम्भुना संकल्पमात्रेण दानवानाममृतस्य हरणम् . शम्भुना त्रिपुरदाहार्थं शरक्षेपणम् . शरक्षेपणसमकालमेव शम्भुना हा कष्टमिति उच्चैः प्रोच्य मयस्य दहनाद्रक्षार्थं नन्दिनो मुखेन (त्रिपुरं दिधक्षते) अनलाय सन्देशप्रेषणम् . वह्निवाक्यान्मयस्य त्रिपुरा- न्निष्क्रम्य पाताले गमनम् . त्रिपुरदाहः . महादेवेन देवानां विसर्जनम् . सगणस्य महादेवस्य कैलास गमनम् .
7.20.m: The advance of Śambhu's chariot toward Tripura, which was situated above the western ocean; tumultuous battle between the gaṇas and the dānavas; the residents of Tripura reviving the dānavas slain in battle with a sprinkling of nectar; at Brahmā's supplication, Śambhu taking away the nectar of the dānavas by mere resolve; Śambhu releasing the arrow to burn Tripura; at the very time of shooting the arrow, Śambhu crying out loudly, "Alas, what misery!" and sending a message to the fire through Nandi's mouth (to fire desiring to burn Tripura) to protect Maya from burning; Maya departing from Tripura at Agni's word and going to Pātāla; the burning of Tripura; Mahādeva bidding farewell to the gods; Mahādeva going to Kailāsa along with his gaṇas.
In the one hundred seventy-first chapter:

7.20.s: guhakṛtaṃ krauñcādāraṇaṃ śakrakṛtaṃ parvatapakṣacchedanaṃ cādhikṛtya vyāsasya sanatkumāraṃ prati praśnaḥ . śarastambavane śakreṇa saha ṣaṇmukhasya vivādaḥ . mithaḥ śreṣṭhatvaparīkṣārthaṃ krauñcapradakṣiṇā . prāthamyaviṣaye punarvivādaḥ . sākṣye sākṣye prakalpitena krauñcena akṛtaparikramasyāpi śakrasya mohāt kṛtaprathamapradakṣiṇatvakathanam . tataḥ kruddhena kumāreṇa krauñcasyopari śaktyā praharaṇam . krauñcasya pañcatvaprāptiḥ . sarveṣāṃ prārthanayā kumāreṇa krauñcasya punarujjīvanam . skandasya parākramapradarśanam . kumārasaṃstavaḥ . mātṝṇāmutpattiḥ . devānāṃ mātṛrūpatvam . īśānasya mātṝ nāyakatvam . koṭivarṣahetukeśvaraśūlakuṇḍapratikūlādipuṇyakṣetrotpattikathanam . nānāvidhamātṛtantrotpattikathanam . koṭivarṣe mātṝṇāmavasthānam .
7.20.d: गुहकृतं क्रौञ्चादारणं शक्रकृतं पर्वतपक्षच्छेदनं चाधिकृत्य व्यासस्य सनत्कुमारं प्रति प्रश्नः . शरस्तम्बवने शक्रेण सह षण्मुखस्य विवादः . मिथः श्रेष्ठत्वपरीक्षार्थं क्रौञ्चप्रदक्षिणा . प्राथम्यविषये पुनर्विवादः . साक्ष्ये साक्ष्ये प्रकल्पितेन क्रौञ्चेन अकृतपरिक्रमस्यापि शक्रस्य मोहात् कृतप्रथमप्रदक्षिणत्वकथनम् . ततः क्रुद्धेन कुमारेण क्रौञ्चस्योपरि शक्त्या प्रहरणम् . क्रौञ्चस्य पञ्चत्वप्राप्तिः . सर्वेषां प्रार्थनया कुमारेण क्रौञ्चस्य पुनरुज्जीवनम् . स्कन्दस्य पराक्रमप्रदर्शनम् . कुमारसंस्तवः . मातॄणामुत्पत्तिः . देवानां मातृरूपत्वम् . ईशानस्य मातॄ नायकत्वम् . कोटिवर्षहेतुकेश्वरशूलकुण्डप्रतिकूलादिपुण्यक्षेत्रोत्पत्तिकथनम् . नानाविधमातृतन्त्रोत्पत्तिकथनम् . कोटिवर्षे मातॄणामवस्थानम् .
7.20.m: Vyāsa's question to Sanatkumāra concerning Guha's piercing of Krauñca and Śakra's clipping of the mountains' wings; the dispute between the Six-faced One [Skanda] and Śakra in the grove of reed-thickets; circumambulating Krauñca to test their relative supremacy; renewed dispute over precedence; Krauñca, who was appointed as witness, stating through delusion that Śakra had made the first circumambulation, even though he had not performed the circumambulation; then the enraged Kumāra striking Krauñca with his spear; Krauñca meeting his death; Kumāra reviving Krauñca at the prayer of all; Skanda displaying his prowess; hymn of praise to Kumāra; origin of the Mothers; the gods assuming the form of the Mothers; Īśāna becoming the master of the Mothers; account of the origin of holy fields such as Koṭivarṣa, Hetukeśvara, Śūlakuṇḍa, and Pratikūlā; account of the origin of various Mātrtantras; the Mothers residing in Koṭivarṣa.
In the one hundred seventy-second chapter:

7.20.s: parvatapakṣacchedopākhyānam- piturvadhamanusmarataḥ prahlādasya vairaniryātanecchayā tapaścaraṇam . brahmaṇaḥ sakāśādaja- yyatvādivaralābhaḥ . prahlādahimavatsaṃvādaḥ . prahlādena devānāṃ vināśāya himavatsakāśe sāhāyyaprārthanam . prahlādavākyāt svaimutpatadbhiḥ parvatairdeśānāmupamardanam . tad dṛṣṭvā kruddhena śakreṇa lokadharmarakṣārthaṃ parvatānāṃ pakṣacchedanam .. prahlādasya viṣṇunā saha vigrahaḥ . prahlādasya pravrajyā . āsureḥ śiṣyatāṃ gatvā pañcaśikhanāmnā khyātiṃ gatasya prahlādasya siddhabhāvena paramapadaprāptiḥ . parvatapakṣacchedopākhyānopasaṃhāraḥ .
7.20.d: पर्वतपक्षच्छेदोपाख्यानम्- पितुर्वधमनुस्मरतः प्रह्लादस्य वैरनिर्यातनेच्छया तपश्चरणम् . ब्रह्मणः सकाशादज- य्यत्वादिवरलाभः . प्रह्लादहिमवत्संवादः . प्रह्लादेन देवानां विनाशाय हिमवत्सकाशे साहाय्यप्रार्थनम् . प्रह्लादवाक्यात् स्वैमुत्पतद्भिः पर्वतैर्देशानामुपमर्दनम् . तद् दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धेन शक्रेण लोकधर्मरक्षार्थं पर्वतानां पक्षच्छेदनम् .. प्रह्लादस्य विष्णुना सह विग्रहः . प्रह्लादस्य प्रव्रज्या . आसुरेः शिष्यतां गत्वा पञ्चशिखनाम्ना ख्यातिं गतस्य प्रह्लादस्य सिद्धभावेन परमपदप्राप्तिः . पर्वतपक्षच्छेदोपाख्यानोपसंहारः .
7.20.m: The story of the clipping of the mountains' wings: Prahlāda, remembering the slaying of his father, performs austerities desiring to take revenge; obtaining boons such as invincibility from Brahmā; dialogue between Prahlāda and Himavat; Prahlāda asking Himavat for assistance in destroying the gods; at Prahlāda's command, mountains flying up on their own and crushing the realms; seeing that, enraged Śakra clips the mountains' wings to protect the order of the world; Prahlāda's conflict with Viṣṇu; Prahlāda's renunciation; Prahlāda becoming a disciple of Āsuri, becoming celebrated by the name Pañcaśikha, and attaining the supreme abode as a perfected being; conclusion of the story of the clipping of the mountains' wings.
In the one hundred seventy-third chapter:

7.20.s: dvijamāhātmyavarṇanam . pārvatyā jijñāsayā mahādevena dvijamāhātmyakathanam . dānarucivipropākhyānam .
7.20.d: द्विजमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् . पार्वत्या जिज्ञासया महादेवेन द्विजमाहात्म्यकथनम् . दानरुचिविप्रोपाख्यानम् .
7.20.m: Description of the māhātmya of the twice-born; Mahādeva recounting the māhātmya of the twice-born upon Pārvatī's inquiry; the story of the brahmin Dānaruci.
In the one hundred seventy-fourth chapter:

7.20.s: ( 1) - pāśupatayogavarṇanam . vyāsasya jijñāsayā sanatkumāreṇa pāśupatayogavarṇanam . yogalakṣaṇam . yogābhyāsodāharaṇam . pratyāhāraprāṇāyāmadhyānadhāraṇānāṃ varṇanam . yoginaḥ prātibhavighnānāṃ tannā- śopāyasya ca kathanam . sāṃkhyasiddhāntanirdeśaḥ .
7.20.d: ( 1) - पाशुपतयोगवर्णनम् . व्यासस्य जिज्ञासया सनत्कुमारेण पाशुपतयोगवर्णनम् . योगलक्षणम् . योगाभ्यासोदाहरणम् . प्रत्याहारप्राणायामध्यानधारणानां वर्णनम् . योगिनः प्रातिभविघ्नानां तन्ना- शोपायस्य च कथनम् . सांख्यसिद्धान्तनिर्देशः .
7.20.m: (1) Description of Pāśupata yoga; Sanatkumāra describing Pāśupata yoga upon Vyāsa's inquiry; the characteristics of yoga; examples of the practice of yoga; description of withdrawal of the senses, breath control, meditation, and concentration; explanation of the intuitive obstacles of a yogin and the means to destroy them; statement of the Sāṃkhya doctrine.
In the one hundred seventy-fifth chapter:

7.20.s: ( 2 )- sāṃkhyatatva vivecanam saṃkṣepeṇa sāṃkhya siddhānta vistaraḥ, sāṃkhyasaṃmatapaṃcaviṃśakasaṃbodhāntamuktiritikatha- nam . pāśupatayogamahimakathanam .
7.20.d: ( 2 )- सांख्यतत्व विवेचनम् संक्षेपेण सांख्य सिद्धान्त विस्तरः, सांख्यसंमतपंचविंशकसंबोधान्तमुक्तिरितिकथ- नम् . पाशुपतयोगमहिमकथनम् .
7.20.m: (2) Investigation of the principles of Sāṃkhya; concise elaboration of the Sāṃkhya doctrine; statement that liberation culminates in awakening to the twenty-fifth [principle] approved by Sāṃkhya; statement of the greatness of Pāśupata yoga.
In the one hundred seventy-sixth chapter:
(3) Detailed description of the origin of a creature, dispassion, and the means of awakening.
In chapter one hundred and seventy-seven:
(4) Description of the rules for the practice of yoga. The greatness of yoga; an account of the true nature of meditators.
In chapter one hundred and seventy-eight:

7.20.s: ( 5) yogino dhyānavidhervarṇanam . yogino lakṣaṇam, yuktasya lakṣaṇam, muktasya lakṣaṇam, yogino dhyānasaṃsiddheḥ sākhyānāṃ tatvaniścayasya māheśvaravidhiṃ vinā na viśeṣātiśayaḥ . praṇavamahimā, praṇavasvarūpam . praṇavacintanam .
7.20.d: ( 5) योगिनो ध्यानविधेर्वर्णनम् . योगिनो लक्षणम्, युक्तस्य लक्षणम्, मुक्तस्य लक्षणम्, योगिनो ध्यानसंसिद्धेः साख्यानां तत्वनिश्चयस्य माहेश्वरविधिं विना न विशेषातिशयः . प्रणवमहिमा, प्रणवस्वरूपम् . प्रणवचिन्तनम् .
7.20.m: (5) Description of the rules of meditation for a yogin. The characteristics of a yogin; the characteristics of one joined [in yoga]; the characteristics of a liberated soul; that for a yogin's attainment of meditation and for the Sāṅkhyas' determination of reality, there is no special excellence without the Māheśvara ordinances. The greatness of the praṇava; the true nature of the praṇava; contemplation of the praṇava.
In chapter one hundred and seventy-nine:

7.20.s: ( 6) - yogavidhivarṇanam . pacaviṃśakapuruṣasvarūpakathanam . ṣaḍviṃśakaparameśvara ( paramapuruṣa) svarūpakathanam ṣaḍviṃśakasyeśvarasya jñānāt muktisiddhiriti kathanam . ṣaḍviṃśakaparameśvaradhyānavidhikathanam . dhyānayogapra- kriyākathanam .
7.20.d: ( 6) - योगविधिवर्णनम् . पचविंशकपुरुषस्वरूपकथनम् . षड्विंशकपरमेश्वर ( परमपुरुष) स्वरूपकथनम् षड्विंशकस्येश्वरस्य ज्ञानात् मुक्तिसिद्धिरिति कथनम् . षड्विंशकपरमेश्वरध्यानविधिकथनम् . ध्यानयोगप्र- क्रियाकथनम् .
7.20.m: (6) Description of the rules of yoga. An account of the true nature of the twenty-fifth principle, the puruṣa. An account of the true nature of the twenty-sixth principle, Parameśvara (the supreme puruṣa); the statement that attainment of liberation comes from knowledge of the twenty-sixth principle, the Lord. An account of the rules of meditation on Parameśvara, the twenty-sixth principle. An account of the procedure of dhyānayoga.
In chapter one hundred and eighty:

7.20.s: ( 7) - pāśupatavratakathanam, pāśupatīdīkṣā, bhasmamāhātmyam, bhasmasnānamahimā, praṇavamahimā, praṇavopāsanā- māhātmyam .
7.20.d: ( 7) - पाशुपतव्रतकथनम्, पाशुपतीदीक्षा, भस्ममाहात्म्यम्, भस्मस्नानमहिमा, प्रणवमहिमा, प्रणवोपासना- माहात्म्यम् .
7.20.m: (7) An account of the Pāśupata observance; the Pāśupatī initiation; the māhātmya of sacred ash; the greatness of bathing in ash; the greatness of the praṇava; the māhātmya of the worship of the praṇava.
In chapter one hundred and eighty-one:

7.20.s: ( 8) - dehāvasthāvarṇanam, jīvasthitivarṇanama, cetanapuruṣasthitikathanam, sātvikādibhāvavarṇanam, jāgradādyava- sthāvarṇanam . dehegnīṣomayoḥ sthitivarṇanam, jīveśvarayorāspadavarṇanam, dhyānayogavarṇanam, maheśvarajñānāt paramapadaprāptikathanam, nāḍīṣu vāyūnāṃ sacārakathanama, māheśvara (pāśupata) yogopasaṃhāraḥ .
7.20.d: ( 8) - देहावस्थावर्णनम्, जीवस्थितिवर्णनम, चेतनपुरुषस्थितिकथनम्, सात्विकादिभाववर्णनम्, जाग्रदाद्यव- स्थावर्णनम् . देहेग्नीषोमयोः स्थितिवर्णनम्, जीवेश्वरयोरास्पदवर्णनम्, ध्यानयोगवर्णनम्, महेश्वरज्ञानात् परमपदप्राप्तिकथनम्, नाडीषु वायूनां सचारकथनम, माहेश्वर (पाशुपत) योगोपसंहारः .
7.20.m: (8) Description of the states of the body; description of the condition of the individual soul; an account of the condition of the conscious puruṣa; description of the sāttvika and other mental states; description of the waking and other states. Description of the presence of fire and soma within the body; description of the dwelling place of the individual soul and the Lord; description of dhyānayoga; an account of attaining the supreme state through knowledge of Maheśvara; an account of the movement of the vital winds through the channels; the conclusion of Māheśvara (Pāśupata) yoga.
In chapter one hundred and eighty-two:

7.20.s: vyāsasya jijñāsayā sanatkumāreṇa prāptayogasya munervinā kleśaṃ svecchayā tanuṃ tyaktvā brahmaprāpterupāyakathanam mokṣasādhanībhūteśvarārādhanasaṃprāptyupāyakathanam . trividhotkrāntikathanam . nāḍīṣu prāṇasaṃcārasya kathanam . utkrāntiprakriyāvarṇanam . niṣkalayogavarṇanopasaṃhāraḥ .
7.20.d: व्यासस्य जिज्ञासया सनत्कुमारेण प्राप्तयोगस्य मुनेर्विना क्लेशं स्वेच्छया तनुं त्यक्त्वा ब्रह्मप्राप्तेरुपायकथनम् मोक्षसाधनीभूतेश्वराराधनसंप्राप्त्युपायकथनम् . त्रिविधोत्क्रान्तिकथनम् . नाडीषु प्राणसंचारस्य कथनम् . उत्क्रान्तिप्रक्रियावर्णनम् . निष्कलयोगवर्णनोपसंहारः .
7.20.m: At the inquiry of Vyāsa, an account by Sanatkumāra of the means for a sage who has attained yoga to shed the body at will without pain and achieve Brahman; an account of the means of attaining worship of the Lord, which serves as the instrument of liberation. An account of the three kinds of departure [of the soul]. An account of the flow of the breath in the channels. Description of the procedure of departure. Conclusion of the description of niṣkala yoga.
In chapter one hundred and eighty-three:

7.20.s: sakalasya śivasya lokasthitiḥ . śivalokavarṇanam, śivapuravarṇanam . purāṇamahimā, upasaṃhāraḥ .
7.20.d: सकलस्य शिवस्य लोकस्थितिः . शिवलोकवर्णनम्, शिवपुरवर्णनम् . पुराणमहिमा, उपसंहारः .
7.20.m: The realm-abiding of Śiva endowed with form (sakala). Description of the realm of Śiva; description of the city of Śiva. The greatness of the Purāṇa; the conclusion.

9.0.s: skandapurāṇasya prastute khaṇḍe samāgatāḥ katipaye śabdāḥ
9.0.d: स्कन्दपुराणस्य प्रस्तुते खण्डे समागताः कतिपये शब्दाः
